articleTitle: Traffic Congestion Detection from Surveillance Videos using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: Countless cameras, both public and private, have been installed in recent years for the objectives of surveillance, the monitoring of anomalous human activities, and traffic surveillance. Numerous worrisome and aberrant actions, such as theft, aggression, and accidents, make it difficult to notice and recognise such behaviour in a real-world setting. The topic of this study is car wrecks as depicted in online videos of traffic. Modern traffic monitoring and surveillance rely heavily on video traffic surveillance cameras (VTSS). Consequences of a rapidly expanding human population include a higher frequency of accidental injuries. The VTSS is employed to identify unusual occurrences on various roads and highways, such as traffic congestion and car accidents. When accidents happen on lengthy roadways or in remote areas, victims are often powerless and some don't make it. The purpose of this study is to provide a method for automatically identifying incidents in surveillance footage. Convolutional-neural-networks (CNNs), a specific deep learning approach developed to cope with grid-like data, have been shown to be useful in image and video processing, according to a study of the relevant literature. This study use a rolling prediction method and convolutional neural networks (CNNs) to detect accidents in VTSS footage. A dataset of anomalous photographs, called the Vehicle Accident Image Dataset (VAID), was created and used in the training of the CNN model. The proposed method was put through its paces by analysing data gathered from running the trained CNN model on a number of different films. This study's findings demonstrate a 93% success rate in identifying traffic accident incidents in films from traffic surveillance systems.

articleTitle: Abnormal Behavior Prediction in Elderly Persons Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: A "smart home" is one in which conveniences like remote monitoring and helpful services are installed to help their residents maintain their sense of autonomy and privacy. When helping an elderly person, it's important to be able to distinguish between the person's typical and atypical actions. Abnormal behaviours noticed while performing ADLs are an excellent predictor of the presence of health and behavioural issues requiring care and support. In this paper, we offer a method for automatically detecting aberrant behaviours in the elderly using long short-term memory recurrent neural networks (LSTM). Our technique can be used to simulate the time-dependent information contained in longitudinal data sets. The purpose of this research is to assess how well LSTM can detect and foresee inappropriate behaviour in the elderly within connected homes. We conducted extensive experiments on a dataset to show that the suggested strategy is effective in predicting abnormal behaviours with a high degree of precision. We also showed that our method is far better than the current gold standard.

articleTitle: Self-Governing Assessment Network (SGAN) Based Super-Resolution for CT chest images
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: Chest cancer is a common and potentially life-threatening disease that affects humanity worldwide. Early detection of chest cancer is critical for successful treatment and improved survival rates. Medical technology advancements in recent years have resulted in the development of various methods for detecting chest cancer. These methods have significantly improved the accuracy and reliability of chest cancer detection. However, the challenge remains to identify chest cancer at an early stage when it is most treatable. Therefore, ongoing research is focused on developing new and innovative approaches to enhance the resolution of CT chest images for early detection of chest cancer. In this paper the Self- Governing Assessment Network (SGAN) model is proposed to produce super resolution images from the low-resolution CT chest images. The proposed SGAN model is tested on 900 chest CT images dataset for super resolution factors 2, 4 and 6 respectively. The proposed model outperformed the existing models with PSNR values 35.82, 36.732, 37.196 and SSIM values 0.914, 0.9421, 0.9653 for super resolution factors 2,4 and 6 respectively.

articleTitle: Design Demonstration of Frequency Reconfiguration Antenna using Varactor diode with SiO2
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: Present paper is especially for the analysis of frequency reconfiguration antenna which removes the problem of achieving multifunctional systems using single antenna at different frequency according to user requirements with enhance performance at low volume. At high frequency from millimetre to terahertz range, data rate and efficient systems are the most important part at less transmission loss to get proper wireless communication. In order to use an antenna at different frequencies for a particular frequency band, a Frequency Reconfigurable Antenna design is proposed using dual patch of gold material structure. It uses SiO2 whose dielectric constant 3.6 (60 × 60 μm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>) as a substrate with a thickness of 1.575 µm. It uses a coaxial feeding with SMA connector and a metal surface at the back of substrate of the same size which act as a reflector. This reflector is used to increase the gain and other characteristics of the antenna by reducing the surface radiation. A varactor diode is used between two patches as a switch for connecting both the patches. By the variation in the value of capacitor, the three different modes as well as different resonating frequencies at those modes are achieved. It exhibits the VSWR < 2. Structure has been simulated using CST microwave studio commercial software. Structure resonates at three different frequencies which is 5.6 THz, 6.2 THz, and 14.6 THz with a maximum gain of 6.44 dBi, 7.75 dBi, and 8.54 dBi respectively.

articleTitle: Federated Learning for Beginners: Types, Simulation Environments, and Open Challenges
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: Federated Learning (FL) is a <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sup> decentralized machine learning (DML) technique. It was introduced by Google research team in 2017, where several clients can train a model collaboratively without sharing their raw data. Unlike centralized machine learning techniques, FL is able to preserve privacy. Since its inception, FL has gained widespread attention and has been the focus of extensive research, resulting in the development of various novel protocols, frameworks, and techniques to address its challenges. Despite these advancements, several research challenges in FL remain unexplored. While there are numerous research articles and tutorials available on FL, a beginner’s guide to this domain is lacking in the literature. Therefore, this paper targets to motivate novice researchers by presenting a simplified and systematic introduction to FL. In addition to introducing FL fundamentals, this paper also highlights some open research areas in the field.

articleTitle: Super Twisting Sliding Mode Control of Small Scale Hybrid Renewable Energy Sources based Power Supply System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: Electrical power supply systems based on hybrid renewable energy sources are gaining popularity in the modern world. Small scale power units typically use hybrid photovoltaic (PV) and PMSG-based wind power conversion technologies. A storage device should be employed to maintain power balance between generation and load in a standalone power supply system due to the fast changes in electrical power generation from both PV and wind. As a result, a battery bank can be used as an energy storage device to maintain power balance and manage the voltage at the dc-link. A PWM based three phase inverter is needed to interface between the dc-link and load bus in order to operate AC loads in distribution systems. To run inverters effectively and enhance the power quality at the AC load bus, a super twisting sliding mode control has been devised. In order to improve the suggested strategy, extensive results using a hardware-in-the-loop on the OPAL-RT platform are investigated in this study.

articleTitle: Relevant Tweets Identification from Disaster-related Tweets
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: Due to the growth in internet users, the information flow from social media platforms like Twitter is revving using micro-posts. These micro-posts share more information in less text to help handle natural crises for people stuck in natural disasters. The first job is to collect the tweets in real-time and classify them into disaster-victim-related tweets that need help and unrelated tweets efficiently. For this, we need to pre-process the tweets so that the problems in the text like ambiguity in words and different spelling for the exact words can be rectified. After that convert these tweets into tokens so that the proposed models can easily train and produce better accuracy.

articleTitle: Maithi-Net: A Customized Convolution Approach for Fake News Detection using Maithili Language
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: Online news consumers now face serious difficulties due to the widespread distribution of fake news on social media platforms. To distinguish fake news from real, the paper suggested a customized CNN model named "Maithi-Net". The model being suggested is composed of five convolution layers which are capable of automatically acquiring the distinguishing features essential for identifying fake news. Both the CGU-Maithili and ISOT fake news datasets have been used to successfully validate the proposed model. The efficacy of the model is verified with several evolution metrics like accuracy, specificity, sensitivity and F1 score. The model provides the detection accuracy 96.85 % for CGU-Maithili and 97.28% for ISOT fake news datasets. The experimental results show substantial gains over prior state-of-the-art results in the area of fake news detection and validate the potential of our method for categorising misinformation spread via social media.

articleTitle: An Improved CCCV Controlled Charging Technique for Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: Quickly rising cost of fossil fuels, global warming, and CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> emissions can all be addressed by using electric vehicles. In electric vehicles, the battery is used to power the electric motor. Due to improved charging methods that are controlled and quick enough, lithium-ion batteries are prominently implemented. A battery charger is designed to charge the battery while considering several factors like capacity, nominal voltage, and state of charge. To maximize the battery’s life cycle and give the necessary quantity of electricity to the EV motor, this paper discusses various charging technologies and their characteristics. The various battery charging types and power levels are introduced. MATLAB Simulation are performed and the results are analyzed for different charging techniques and which technique will be much suitable for on-board charger of the proposed lithium-ion battery (48 volts and 72 Ah capacity) for electric vehicles.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of GaN Inverter fed Electric Traction Drive System for EV Application
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: In this paper, the performance analysis of Wide Band Gap (WBG) device made of Gallium Nitride (GaN) is analyzed in depth for its implementation in electric traction drive system employing the Maximum Torque per Ampere Control (MTPA) as a method of speed control for controlling the Interior Permanent Magnet Synchronous Machine (IPMSM). The GaN based HEMT devices are employed in the inverter design to implement the MTPA speed control, and the inverter’s complete loss analysis were performed using MATLAB Simulink and PLECS. In this work, MTPA control is used instead of Zero d-axis control because it reduces current while producing the same torque as ZDAC control. Furthermore, to reduce losses, a low loss GaN inverter is used, making the overall control method a highly efficient method for use in EVs. Complete loss analysis was performed using PLECS software, and it was found that GaN-based inverters have lower losses than Silicon carbide (SiC) inverters and Silicon inverters.

articleTitle: IoT Based Smart Greenhouse Using Raspberry Pi
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: The main goal of this project is to implement live monitoring and plant disease detection in smart greenhouses because, even though greenhouses are automatic by using the different types of components, But the problem is users still have to go check how plants are growing and check whether plants are affected by any disease or not. In our society, everyone wants to grow their own garden and live in greenery. Some people want to grow their own vegetables because of the increase in inorganic food production. Inorganic foods are those that rely on synthetic products, such as chemical fertilizers and pesticides, in their production. People are busy with their work; they do not have time and need labour to look after their gardens. To solve the aforementioned issue, we are developing an IoT-based smart green house. A smart greenhouse is nothing but a glasshouse, in which we can grow plants irrespective of seasonal change, which consist of different types of hardware components like the controller (Raspberry Pi), Camera, PIR sensor, gas sensor, DHT sensor, LDR sensor, smoke sensor, motor, lights, and fans, to make the greenhouse automatic.

articleTitle: Design of FOPID controller for Riverol-Pilipovik Water Treatment Plant Exploiting Jaya Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: This research manuscript focuses on the development of a robust Fractional Order PID (FOPID) controller, which incorporates both integral order and differential order in addition to the conventional parameters to enhance the effectiveness of the control system. The controller is designed to meet performance criterion such as the frequency domain specifications of gain cross-over frequency and phase margin. The simulation results obtained from implementation on a reduced-order model indicate the superiority of FOPID controllers in performance, when compared to a conventional PID controller, for a water treatment plant. Additionally, the FOPID controller formulated for a first-order model is also effective for the original system of higher-order.

articleTitle: Automatic Nuclei Segmentation Method using Median Filter for Denoising
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: Nuclei deliver vast information about the microenvironment. The workload of pathologists can be reduced and precise observations of the microenvironment for clinical research can be made with an automatic nucleus segmentation approach. Although the present deep-learning (DL) based nuclei segmentation techniques generally outperform the conventional ones, this task is still challenging particularly when the nuclei present are cohesive and overlap with one another. In the present work, we have proposed a new nuclei segmentation technique in which we are using a median filter for the pre-processing of the source image along with the U-Net convolution neural network (CNN) model. The median filter can remove the noise present in the source image keeping the edge information preserved. The pre-processing step used enhances the efficacy of the proposed segmentation technique. The performance of the proposed method is compared with the existing techniques for nuclei segmentation on a similar dataset. The proposed technique attained IOU(JI), Accuracy, Precision, and F1 score values as 0.8024, 96.23%, 0.8895, and 0.8704 respectively. The empirical findings indicate that the performance of our proposed technique is better as compared to the other existing methods.

articleTitle: Citrus fruit disease prediction using ML on a decentralized and secure smart platform
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: Agriculture plays a vital role in society, and in recent years, researchers have increasingly turned to the Internet of Things (IoT) to gather data and develop innovative approaches to disease prediction. Storing all the gathered data in a Blockchain network has revolutionized the agricultural field. By integrating Blockchain, IoT, machine learning (ML), and cloud computing, farmers can now predict diseases more accurately while optimizing the use of natural resources. This paper used ML approach to classify citrus fruit diseases. IoT devices are used in agriculture to take data. These data are being passed through the gateway devices for classification. Various deep learning (DL) models such as AlexNet, VGG19, Xception, ResNet101, MobileNetV2, and ShuffleNet are employed to extract valuable features from the collected dataset. These DL models play a crucial role in feature extraction. The extracted features are then utilized for classification purposes, where a support vector machine (SVM) is commonly applied for classification. Additionally, an efficient device authentication mechanism is implemented to ensure the security and integrity of the system. The experimental results show that the Xception with SVM performs better than other models. Furthermore, the data is kept on a cloud-based Blockchain network to ensure stability, availability, immutability, security, and privacy in a smart agricultural setting.

articleTitle: Comparative analysis of Vid2Vid and Fast Vid2Vid Models for Video-to-Video Synthesis on Cityscapes Dataset
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: Video generation refers to the process of creating videos using computational methods with the help of deep learning algorithms. With the advancement of deep learning techniques and the availability of large datasets, video generation has become more sophisticated and has the potential to revolutionize various industries, including entertainment, advertising, and education. This comparative review of video-to-video synthesis models is done to understand the working of both the Vid2Vid and Fast Vid2Vid model. In this comparative review, Vid2Vid delivers 3.44 FID and 0.92 Human Preference Score. In contrast, Fast Vid2Vid, with a two-stage training process, fine-tunes the Vid2Vid model on segmented images and gains 3.10 FID and 0.97 Human Preference Score. Fast Vid2Vid generates high-quality videos at a faster speed than Vid2Vid, making it more suitable for various applications like video editing, video creation, virtual try-on and so on.

articleTitle: Hybrid Model for Image Forgery Detection In Smart Healthcare
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: Smart Healthcare Systems (SHS) are gradually replacing traditional healthcare systems that involve human intervention. This is due to the advancement of IOT devices and also the introduction of edge computing. SHS provides security, flexibility, and efficiency. A key feature of SHS is to transport images from one place to another in real-time. Due to technological advancements, these images can tamper which is image forgery, this threats security in SHS. To tackle this problem, Image Forgery Detection using Support Vector Machines (SVM) and Extreme Learning Machines (ELM) is proposed in this model. We combine the scores of both SVM and ELM using Bayesian Sum Rule (BSR). The model is utilized to verify if the forgery is done or not. This model can be inbuilt into the SHS. Forgery Detection enhances security and reduces the threat of systems being failed, as images play a key role in the treatment procedure.

articleTitle: Implementation of an E-Bike Charger Using Cuk Converter and Resonant LLC Converter
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: This paper offers a two-wheeler e-bike charging technique. A Cuk converter is used to construct an electric bike charger (EBC), which is then followed by an HBLLC resonant converter with better input power quality. Due to the pulse width modulation (PWM) functioning of the Cuk converter’s discontinuous conduction mode (DCM), the input current is shaped utilizing a voltage follower technique. As a result, the control loop is simpler since it only has one voltage loop. The battery charging technique employs a half-bridge LLC, diode rectification, and a resonant converter with variable frequency control. To charge a 20Ah e-bike battery, a 550W constant current/constant voltage (CC/CV) charger with the highest current rating may also be used to charge. The range of output voltage varies from 42V to 80V in e-bike, and it is increased by a variable DC link voltage reference estimator, that modifies the DC link voltage. A resonant frequency optimization method is also recommended to reduce turn-off losses while recharging severely depleted batteries. The performance of this charger has been meticulously tested in steady-state and dynamic conditions, and it was observed that the input power quality complies with international standard IEC-61000-3-2.

articleTitle: Design of Edge Slotted Waveguide Scanned Linear Array antenna with Low Side Lobe Levels for X-Band Radar Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: The paper describes the design and development of an edge slotted waveguide scanned linear array antenna for X-Band radar applications. Fourth order polynomial equation with interpolation is used for accurate calculation of necessary slot parameters; slot angle and slot depth. Linear array of 1 meter with 54 slots inclined slots on the narrow wall is designed in the frequency band 9.1-9.5 GHz. The prototype is fabricated, tested and the measured results are in close agreement with simulation results. Side Lobe level (SLL) better than -28 dB was achieved against the simulated value of -29.4 dB at the center frequency (9.3 GHz).

articleTitle: Multilingual Obnoxious Message Classification using Bidirectional Encoder Representation from Transformers (BERT)
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: Everyday we witness incidents of social media bullying, harassment and various other toxic remarks. It has now become the part and parcel of social networking. Promotion of violence and hate speech, etc involve toxic comments in various forms on social media. The proposed model in this paper helps with the identification of all the obnoxious and questionable content on the internet by classifying the online comments as toxic or clean to tackle this problem. This is realised by using a pre-trained model - BERT. To enhance the performance, this model used RoBERTa (Robustly Optimized BERT Pre Training Approach), which has basically been formed by altering some hyperparameters which are tuned during the pre-training of BERT.

articleTitle: Urban Built-up Extraction Using SAR Polarimetry with Feature Combination and Machine Learning Technique
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: The task of built-up extraction using Polarimetric SAR is of great significance for mapping disaster-induced building damage. In general, buildings are expected to exhibit even bounce polarimetric signatures. However, rotated urban targets concerning the radar line of sight tend to exhibit volume scattering. This makes it difficult to distinguish from vegetation and other natural sources of volume scatter. This experiment represents a study on the extraction of urban built-up using different polarimetric SAR features. The investigation uses C and L band fully polarimetric San Francisco bay area data. Features extracted from Sentinel-1A include Texture, Coherence, and Colour. The contribution of various backscatter components from model-based decomposition techniques is investigated. L and C bands are classified using deep transfer learning classification for the best-suited model to classify urban. The comparative analysis of combined feature models to classify urban results with L-band better accuracy, whether a significant increase in accuracy for C - band has been observed. The results indicate that the polarimetric parameters combined with some SAR image features of the L- band has a good potential for urban mapping in this study area.

articleTitle: A Novel High Gain Non-Isolated Three-port Converter for Stand-Alone PV Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: The structure of a novel three port DC-DC converter with improved voltage gain, having comparable efficiency is proposed in this work. Design of the proposed converter is discussed in detail for 200W power level. Besides this, various power transfer modes across the ports are scrutinized and deliberated for stand-alone Photovoltaic application. Unlike other high gain converters, gain is improved without using coupled inductor and voltage multiplier cells. Theoretical conclusions are validated through simulation and the results are presented for 200W power level. Various features of the converter are compared with other recently reported three port converters to appreciate the proposed converter and are tabulated in this paper.

articleTitle: Lithium-Ion Battery’s SOH Estimation Using Machine Learning with Multi-Channel Charging Profiles
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: Several applications, including battery systems, have used prognostics and health management to guard against future breakdowns. For safe operation and decision-making, due to its characteristics of battery capacity is essential. In this work, we use measurable data from the battery management system, such as Voltage, current, and temperature profiles, which change over time due to aging. We discover the connection between capacity and charge profiles using neural networks. We use long short-term memory, convolution neural networks, and feed-forward neural networks to estimate health status reliably. Our suggested multi-channel strategy performs better than the established technique that uses a voltage profile, displaying a reduction in mean absolute percentage error of up to 25-58 percentages.

articleTitle: Anomaly Detection: A Machine Learning and Deep Learning Perspective
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: Anomaly detection involves finding data points that don’t follow the usual trends followed by the rest of the dataset. There exist several computationally efficient anomaly detection methods in data science. This paper explores and compares various machine learning and deep learning techniques. Anomaly detection can be a tricky task due to a multitude of reasons including highly imbalanced datasets, low amounts of data on actual frauds, unpredictable nature of the problem. The transaction in question does not necessarily need to be an outlier, which makes the problem contextual as well. Having performed fraud detection on credit card fraud and healthcare provider fraud datasets, we have been able to draw certain inferences as to which algorithms work best under which scenarios. Random Forest Classifier, XGBoost Classifier, Isolation Forests, Artificial Neural Networks, and Autoencoders are few of the prominent algorithms tested. After testing the algorithms, the results show that some algorithms work better with imbalanced datasets, while others can handle noise very well. We have also tried using certain dimensionality reduction methods in order to remove noise and improve efficiency, and certain sampling methods to handle class imbalances and then compared their results on these datasets.

articleTitle: An Approximate Full-Adder to Eliminate Carry Propagation in Lower Significant Stage of a Multi-Digit Adder
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: Approximate computing is prominently used in software and hardware design to optimize area, delay, and power consumption by exploiting the implicit tolerance for inaccuracy in applications. Adders are the vital building blocks of such error-tolerant and error-resilient applications. Though accurate adders give exact results, performance metrics like critical path delay, area overhead, and power consumed are improved in inaccurate adders. Motivated by this, we propose an approximate single digit full adder (AFA) using which addition of lower significant bits is implemented in an approximate multi-digit adder. The proposed multi-digit adder is a high-speed, area-efficient, and power-efficient architecture compared to the existing architectures. Computation accuracy in the least significant bits is sacrificed to improve the performance metrics of the adder. The trade-off between hardware cost and accuracy is also considered in proposed multi-digit inaccurate adder. Simulation results and mathematical model analysis show the advantage of proposed inaccurate multi-digit adder when compared to the existing architectures. Error analysis of the proposed inaccurate multi-digit adder proves that it is less prone to errors. Simulation results show that the image quality metrics like Mean Square Error (M.S.E), Peak Signal to Noise Ratio (PSNR), and Structural Similarity Index (SSIM) are also better for the proposed inaccurate multi-digit adder when compared to the existing architectures.

articleTitle: A Differential Geometry Perspective to Study Power and Harmonics in Three-Phase Circuits
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: This work introduces a method for analyzing three- phase circuits using insights from the differential geometry of curves. Differential geometry's curvature and torsion indicators are presented for studying the behavior of three-phase systems when harmonics are present. The concept of angular frequency has also been reviewed considering the Darboux vector. Finally, a geometric interpretation of power is offered for various loads, with voltages and currents expressed per the Frenet Frame orthonormal set.

articleTitle: Real-Time Traffic Signal Prediction and Control using Deep Q-Network
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: As cities grow and populations rise, an increasing number of people are taking to the roads in their personal vehicles. However, traditional traffic systems are failing to cope with this change as the infrastructure has not kept pace with the growth. Therefore, Intelligent Traffic Signals(ITS) are becoming a crucial area of research in order to address this issue. This paper proposes an ITS that utilizes YOLO and DeepSORT to detect and track each vehicle, enabling the system to calculate the traffic density. This information is then fed into a Fuzzy Inference System that selects the appropriate mode of operation for the system. These modes include Normal mode (for typical traffic conditions), Priority mode (for high traffic conditions), and Emergency mode (for the presence of emergency vehicles). Normal and Priority modes can be further divided into two sub-modes to handle intermediate conditions. DQN is used to determine the appropriate phase of the signal based on the traffic density and the mode of operation selected by the Fuzzy Inference System.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of WBG Based High Power Dense T-Type Inverter for Next Generation Carbon Neutral Energy Application
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: The presented paper describes a typical three phase three level T-type neutral point clamped (3L-TNPC) power dense inverter that uses Wide Band Gap (WBG) devices as power switches for next generation carbon neutral energy application. The total power losses generated in the proposed inverter feeding a 22 KVA industrial grid power are investigated, as are the generated junction temperatures for the various operating loads. The proposed inverter losses for various modulation techniques such as Third Harmonic Injection PWM (THIPWM), Third Harmonic Zero Sequence PWM (THZSPWM), and discontinuous PWM pattern are evaluated (DPWM1). In the proposed inverter, the Wolfspeed Silicon Carbide (SiC) MOSFET with Model Number C3M0065100K is used for loss analysis.. Further the Thermal Model files with switching losses and conduction losses are generated in the PLECS software. A separate thermal description file are made for the MOSFET and the Body Diode in the PLECS software. The proposed 3L-TNPC inverter with SVPWM Modulation technique shows less losses when grid is running at power factor from 0.75 to 0.85 which is the practical running value of the grid in industrial loads.

articleTitle: Video-based road accident detection on highways: A less complex YOLOv5 approach
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: Advancement of Artificial Intelligence (AI) technologies and the availability of high-end computing devices create scope for the implementation of intelligent transport infrastructure for road safety. This paper proposes an intelligent model for accident detection on highways using more robust, less complex, and more accurate YOLOv5 and StrongSort to locate and track vehicles. It provides a reliable approach for detecting accidents based on vehicle speed, acceleration, trajectory anomalies, and area anomalies. The methodology follows three major steps. The first stage performs vehicle detection, the next stage performs vehicle tracking and feature extraction, and the last stage does crash detection. In this study, only vehicle detection and tracking are addressed using a deep learning-based methodology. However, the accident prediction is done by an algorithm using threshold levels of various parameters such as the speed of vehicles, acceleration anomalies, etc. The model shows good performance when evaluated using the test crash videos under different ambient conditions such as daylight and night.

articleTitle: A Study on Single Phase On-Board Charger Topologies for Light Electric Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: In the case of electric mobility, the effectiveness and quality of the charging process are crucial. Significant customer repercussions will occur if electricity is not maintained. The on-board chargers use single-stage and two-stage charging technologies. Light Electric Vehicles (LEV) chargers should be economical, light in weight, with minimal losses, enhanced power-factor, and minimized distortion. The front end of the converters uses a variety of power electronic circuits with power factor adjustment techniques. In this article, various converter topologies utilized in vehicle charging solutions are explored, and a comparison is made between these converters.

articleTitle: Resonance Damping in Active Power Decoupled Single-Phase Grid-tied Differential Buck Inverter
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: The single-phase differential buck inverter allows active decoupling of the double-line frequency ripple power without employing the additional switching devices. The ripple energy storage is realized by two filter capacitors connected between the ac side terminals and the negative dc bus. The grid current control is attained by controlling the differential mode voltage of the ac side capacitors. The active power decoupling is achieved by controlling the common mode voltage such that the ripple power on the dc side is eliminated, allowing the use of a small and reliable film capacitor on the dc side sufficient to avoid the switching frequency current from the dc source. The present work comprehensively details the plant modeling and control design for the differential buck grid-tied inverter. It is analytically shown that the system’s differential mode and common mode plants are highly under damped due to the presence of LCL and LC resonances, respectively. Subsequently, the design of active damping loops is presented and shown to improve system stability. Further, the controller designs for grid current and active power decoupling are discussed. Finally, simulation results are presented to validate the analytical inferences derived in the paper.

articleTitle: Privacy Protection and Cost of Privacy in Smart Grid
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: Smart Grid is closely integrated with new technologies such as the internet of things, advanced information communication technologies, sensor measurement, and automatic control technologies, including many smart devices. A smart meter is a key component of the smart grid. The data collected from the smart meter can be used to control and manage power grids. These data provide considerable benefits to the system operator and the consumers but raise issues related to the privacy of individual customer information. One method to provide differential privacy for individual customers is to add noise to the aggregated demand. However, noisy demand affects the optimality of the system. This article optimizes noise in demand reporting and calculates the additional system cost due to this noise. In addition, to distribute the extra cost among the customers fairly and equitably, the Shapley value method is used. The effect of line congestion on the privacy cost is also analysed and results shows that privacy cost is increased due to line congestion.

articleTitle: Detection of Leaf Diseases in Agricultural Plants Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: Identifying plant leaves early on is key to preventing catastrophic outbreaks. An important study area is automatic disease detection in plants. Fungi, bacteria, and viruses are the main culprits in most plant illnesses. Choosing a classification method is always challenging because the quality of the results can differ depending on the input data. A few examples of several classification techniques include K-Nearest Neighbour Classifier (KNN), Probabilistic Neural Network (PNN), Genetic Algorithm, Support Vector Machine (SVM) and Principal Component Analysis, Artificial Neural Network (ANN), and Fuzzy Logic. Classifications of plant leaf diseases have many uses in various industries, including agriculture and biological research. Pre-symptomatic diagnosis and crop health information can aid in the ability to manage pathogens through proper management approaches. Convolutional neural networks (CNNs) are the most widely used DL models for computer vision issues since they have proven very effective in tasks like picture categorization, object detection, image segmentation, etc. The experimental findings demonstrate the proposed model’s superior performance to pre-trained models such as VGG16 and InceptionV3. The range of categorization accuracy is 76% to 100%, based on.

articleTitle: MRI Based Multiple Brain Disease Detection using Lightweight Deep Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: As the population is growing and aging, the ubiquity of neurological disorders is increasing. If these disorders are not treated at an early stage, they may pose a significant threat. To avoid further complications, the presence of these diseases must be detected as quickly as possible. With the existing pattern recognition-based techniques, an individual brain illness can be identified at a time using MRI images. It is noteworthy that the existing approaches are not capable of assisting a skilled physician or deducing a result about multiple diseases from the MRI images like a professional clinical technician can do. Through this research, the objective is to predict multiple brain illnesses, or the probability of their existence based on MRI data. To achieve this goal, dataset for Normal, Alzheimer and Brain Tumor has been used from Kaggle and combined to train a 12-layer lightweight sequential model with 2 million trainable parameters. which gave close to 98.9% accuracy for the three classes on testing data.

articleTitle: Tantalum disulfide (TaS2) Based Novel Surface Plasmon Resonance Sensor with Enhanced Sensitivity using Aluminium Arsenide(AlAs)and Thallium Bromide(TlBr)
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: In this paper, a new SPR biosensor design is proposed that employs tantalum disulfide (TaS<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>) and offers increased sensitivity. The performance of the sensor is improved by incorporating Aluminum Arsenide (AlAs) and Thallium Bromide (TlBr) layers in its design. The proposed sensor design makes use of the exceptional features of TaS<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>, which display a remarkable sensitivity towards variations in refractive index and demonstrate excellent stability. By incorporating AlAs and TlBr layers into the sensor structure, the proposed SPR biosensor demonstrated a substantial improvement in sensitivity, making it capable of detecting low-concentration analytes with high accuracy. The effectiveness of the sensor is assessed by testing it with various analytes, and the outcomes show that the suggested sensor displays outstanding sensitivity, stability, and specificity. The proposed sensor has promising applications in various fields, including biomedical sensing, environmental monitoring, and food safety.

articleTitle: Styled-QReal: A real-time technique for QR code stylisation
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: Today QR codes are one of the most widely used scannable patterns, especially in the digital payments ecosystem in India. Traditionally QR codes are made up of randomly appearing black and white square pixels that don’t carry any visual meaning to the normal human being. Hence, this motivates the recent works on beautifying the visual aesthetics of these QR codes. In this paper, we have used the neural style transfer technique to propose an algorithm to generate scannable and robust stylised QR codes in real-time with artistic visual quality, suitable for real-world applications. Also, the experiments performed on the generated QR codes reveal that our QR codes have visual quality at par with existing methods while having better scanning robustness.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Quality of Service Parameters for LoRaWAN IoT Driven Smart Dustbin Service
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: All over the world, urban areas often need help collecting garbage, such as household waste, industrial waste, and debris waste, on time. If the waste is not collected periodically, trash can overflow. This results in an unpleasant smell and may cause the spread of diseases. Smart dustbins are implemented in smart cities to elevate the above problems. Inevitably, the quality of service must be considered when smart dustbins are deployed in smart cities. Quality of service is a prominent issue that may hamper the adoption and growth of smart dustbin services. The existing literature discussed the deployment of smart dustbins and garbage classification in smart cities and did not focus on the channel quality of service parameters. This research proposes a reliable Internet of Things (IoT)-powered Long Range Wide Area Network (LoRaWAN) smart dustbin use case to address the abovementioned problems. The channel quality of service (QoS) parameters such as received signal strength indicator (RSSI), signal-to-noise (SNR), coding rate (CR), and spreading factor (SF) are monitored and evaluated using Raspberry Pi to guarantee the quality of service. The proposed approach helps to deliver a garbage-free hygienic environment with the most significant opportunities to guarantee quality in smart dustbins' management.

articleTitle: A Machine Learning Approach for Autism Spectrum Disorder Detection using BOLD-fMRI Signals and ABIDE-II Dataset
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: Autism spectrum disorder (ASD) is a neurodevelopmental disorder affecting nearly 1 in 60 children worldwide. The main issue in ASD treatment has no definite cure and the only solution to this is to control the disorder’s progression. Traditional ASD diagnosis mainly relies on subjective measures which is wholly a behavioural-dependent approach and may lead to delayed diagnosis. To overcome this, existing studies have shifted towards neuroimaging biomarkers which are more objective and can help in detecting ASD at an early stage. The implementation of machine learning techniques as a diagnostic tool for ASD is rapidly growing in the field of neuroscience and has greater possibilities in discriminating between ASD and controlled children. Several automated models for effective and early ASD diagnosis using machine learning and fMRI have been reported. However, these models barely reach an accuracy of nearly upto 60-70 percent. Most of these ASD studies have been conducted using ABIDE I database that has been created earlier. In this study, we presented a classification technique to analyze functional brain connectivity by utilizing the newly developed database ABIDE II which is a multisite data aggregated from three different sites. Various classification algorithms: Support Vector Machine (SVM), Logistic Regression (LR) and Random forest (RF) have been employed and the results show that the RF outperforms the other two techniques by yielding an optimal classification accuracy of 75 percent which is much more relative to the previous works.

articleTitle: Single-Phase Single-Stage PFC Converter with Soft Switching for EV Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: For applications involving the battery charging of electric vehicles, there is a constant need for onboard chargers that are reliable, effective, compact, and lightweight. Conventional EV charger uses a two-stage configuration, which employs a PFC stage for input side power factor correction followed by a dc-dc converter for battery side requirement. However, traditional EV chargers have high costs and low power density due to a large number of components. This article presents a high efficiency single stage onboard charger with soft switching characteristics and a compact size. Interleaved topology leads to a reduction in input current ripple and reduces size of passive components. Mathematical modeling, analysis, and controller design for the proposed converter configuration under various operational modes are described in this article. The proposed converter is built in the simscape electrical toolbox of MATLAB software. At last, MATLAB simulation results are used to validate the converter’s steady state and dynamic performance.

articleTitle: SegFishHead: A Semantic Segmentation Approach for the identification of fish species in a Cluttered Environment
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: Identifying fish species, in general and in a cluttered environment in particular, is not an easy task for common people without the proper knowledge of fish taxonomy. This study proposes a challenging segmentation dataset consisting of fish images collected from different live fish markets situated in West Bengal, India. A total of five freshwater fish species named, Labeo catla, Labeo rohita, Cirrhinus mrigala, Labeo bata, and Hypophthalmichthys molitrix are considered in this study. A semantic segmentation-based fish head segmentation and identification in a cluttered environment is proposed in this study. Two popular deep learning-based segmentation networks, U-Net and PSPNet, are applied with two different pre-trained backbone networks, ResNet34 and InceptionV3. Using PSPNet with a ResNet34 pre-trained backbone, a best mean IoU of 0.76 is achieved by taking the background of the image as a class label. The fishing industries as well as their stakeholders will benefit from this proposed approach in a variety of contexts.

articleTitle: Gyroscope Aided Blur Kernel Estimation for IR Image Deblurring
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: Stabilized Electro-Optical Systems are used in multiple domains, like target detection, tracking, and area surveillance. Cooled thermal imagers are used for long range surveillance. The requirement of a fast steering speed of the gimbal during surveillance induces blur in the captured IR video frames, which is required to be correct in real-time. Existing blind deblurring methods take a long time to execute. Deep learning methods are fast but cannot be generalised for all practical scenarios. In this work, we propose a noble blur kernel estimation method, using inertial sensor, and integrate it with existing non-blind deblurring methods and a sensor based deep learning method. Our method shows good results and is a suitable candidate for deblurring the image captured by gimbal-based imaging systems.

articleTitle: Three Dimensional Hand Movement Tracking with Machine Learning and Stereo Camera
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: A novel methodology is suggested to track the hand movement in 3-dimensions, using a computer vision based machine learning model to identify various points on the hand and doing it repeatedly in each frame . The proposed method is based on Stereo camera setup to calculate the change in depth, in which, the hand is recognized at different points using machine learning in both cameras and is used to calculate the change in position with respect to a initial position. The Computer vision machine learning model is implemented on python. The displacement is recorded with respect to the starting position of the hand initialized, co-ordinates are printed on the camera window as well as exported to a CSV file. The various positions of the hand are observed and the displacement from initial recorded.

articleTitle: Assessment of Bulk Acoustic Wave Based Solidly Mounted Resonator (BAW-SMR) as Ozone Sensor Using ITO Sensitive Layer
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: In this paper, a highly sensitive ozone sensor based on a Bulk Acoustic Wave based Solidly Mounted Resonator (BAW-SMR) is reported using Indium Tin Oxide (ITO) as ozone-sensitive material on the top of the resonator. The resonant frequency of the resonator is 4944 MHz and due to 4 ppb ozone gas adsorption, the frequency downshifts by 750 kHz and the resultant sensitivity of the sensor is 187.5 kHz/ppb. In addition to it optimized number of Bragg pairs ((Mo/SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>) is also investigated. The ozone sensor modeling is done by Finite Element Method (FEM) model and the Bragg reflector modeling is done by the Mason model respectively. A comparison of the proposed ozone sensor to other acoustic resonator based ozone sensors is also presented in this paper.

articleTitle: IoT based automated mosquito based disease Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: Mosquitoes in India has a wide impact in spreading diseases like, dengue, Malaria, Zika virus, Chikangunia. They cause a wide casualty in terms of life due to mosquito. The paper finds the actual environmental parameters causing the wide spread and breeding of mosquitoes in the state of Uttarakhand. The paper provide a real time design of IoT based product for finding the areas of uttarakhand which got affected from mosquitoes on real time basis based on environmental parameters responsible for providing the favourable conditions for these mosquitoes to breed and spread in the area which causes such type of diseases due to mosquitoes.

articleTitle: Income model for EV public charging station in India
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: This paper provides the scope for installing the public charging station (PCS) across India by suggesting an income model and cost estimates for setting up a typical PCS in India. The income model details the capital and operating expenses of a typical public electric vehicle (EV) charging station that would be installed in India and is based on the requirements and guidelines of the Ministry of Power, Govt. of India. The paper finally concludes that the net revenue generated from the PCS business is Rs. 18 lakhs over 5 years including initial capital costs and projected operating costs of Rs. 29.55 lakhs and Rs. 9.72 lakhs, respectively. This income model can help enable the EV charging ecosystem for faster electric vehicle adoption in India.

articleTitle: An efficient drug synergy model based on deep learning for malignant diseases
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: Malignant diseases are the leading cause of mortality worldwide. Drug resistance is one of the significant reasons for mortality in malignant diseases. Chemical treatment involves the administration of many drugs, either all at once or in a specific order, intending to minimize the size of a tumor or eliminate it. With the combination of drugs or drug synergy, the therapeutic response of drugs is greater than the expected additive monotherapy. The identification of synergistic drugs with clinical trials is a time-consuming and expensive task. Due to a lack of available resources, it is impracticable to screen all of the essential synergistic drugs. The introduction of artificial intelligence (AI) has not only altered our perspective but also presented new approaches to old challenges. One area where significant progress has been made because to AI advancements is the prediction of drug synergy based on deep learning in the treatment of malignant diseases. In this paper, we provide a unique deep learning-based drug synergy model for malignant diseases. The proposed model is used to determine the most successful synergistic drug combinations, and it may also increase the practicality of exploring new drug combinations.

articleTitle: Multi Scale aided Deep Learning model for High F1-score classification of fundus images based Diabetic Retinopathy and Glaucoma
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: Diabetic Retinopathy (DR) and Glaucoma (GL) are leading causes of irreversible visual loss in individuals aged 30-45 years due to optic nerve and retinal blood vessel damage. Fundus images of the retina are used to investigate DR & GL, but manual screening is error-prone, laborious, and tedious. Capturing fundus images with different fields of view and resolutions may result in the loss of important features, leading to misclassification. This paper proposes a multi-scale aided Deep Learning (DL) model for accurate DR & GL classification. To reduce the computational burden, an Atrous Spatial Pyramid Pooling (ASPP) layer is introduced to transfer features to the DL model-based classifier. Precision, Recall and accuracy are improved by incorporating Soft F1-Loss and Categorical Cross Entropy (CCE) Loss in the modified Loss function, enhancing the F1-score and Accuracy. The proposed model is validated using different DL models on a dataset of 10,500 images from different public and private databases. The results show that the Multi-scale RESNET50 model achieves 87.5% accuracy and 0.89 F1-score, outperforming the Multi-scale Deep Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) model. This approach offers a promising solution for accurate DR & GL detection, facilitating early diagnosis and intervention in these sight-threatening conditions.

articleTitle: Mathematical Modeling and Analysis of Energy Dissipation in Magnetorheological Dampers
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: This paper represents a comparative analytical study of energy dissipation in Magnetorheological (MR) dampers to that of hydraulic dampers. Simulation studies suggests that MR dampers are prone to high energy dissipation, even beyond hydraulic dampers after attaining some particular excitation frequency which is a major disadvantage. Frequency clamping has been used to solve this issue, where MR damper energy dissipation after a critical frequency is made equal to the energy dissipation of hydraulic dampers and hence an advantageous method to avoid energy loss in MR dampers when the road excitation frequency increases. Comparison of the MR damper and the hydraulic damper reveals the ideal circumstances for their use in automobiles.

articleTitle: A comparative analysis of reflective and transmissive PPG sensor in pulse acquisition system
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: This study aimed to compare the performance of PPG (Photoplethysmography) sensors, based on time domain signals, frequency domain spectra, correlation coefficients, mean square errors, and signal-to-noise ratios (SNR). Two types PPG sensors were used: reflective and a transmissive PPG sensor. MAX30100 is a reflective PPG sensor used to acquiring the signal from the fingertip. Time domain signals acquired using the reflective PPG sensor contained more noise and motion artifacts than those acquired using the transmissive PPG sensor. The IR and RED-light absorption patterns from the MAX30100 were similar in time domain. The transmissive PPG sensor provided clearer pulse features than the reflective PPG sensor. The systolic wave phase showed more fluctuations in the IR and RED reflective PPG sensor. The correlation coefficients indicated a strong correlation between IR and RED PPG sensors and moderate correlation between IR and transmissive PPG sensor and RED and transmissive PPG sensor. The SNR values were found to be 14 dB for IR PPG, 11 dB for Red PPG, and 41 dB for transmissive PPG. These results suggest that transmissive PPG sensors are more reliable for pulse analysis compared to reflective PPG sensors.

articleTitle: Genetic algorithm based approach for solving Roman {3}-domination problem
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract:
Different Roman domination variants have been proposed by researchers to provide better defense strategies under different constraints. A Roman {3}-Dominating Function (RTDF) h on an undirected, simple graph G is a mapping h : V (G) →{0,1,2,3} with two conditions that $\sum
olimits_{v \in N(u)} h (v) \geq 3$, if h(u) = 0, and $\sum
olimits_{v \in N(u)} h (v) \geq 2$, if h(u) = 1, where N(u) is the neighbors of vertex u in G. The weight of a RTDF h is the sum $h(V) = \sum
olimits_{v \in V} h (v)$. Given a graph G, the problem of determining minimum weight of a RTDF of G (also known as Roman {3}-domination number) is known as the Roman {3}-domination problem (MRTDP) and is known to be NP-hard. However no efficient approximation algorithm has been proposed to solve MRTDP. Hence in this paper, we propose a genetic algorithm based approach for solving MRTDP in which four heuristic algorithms have been proposed and a problem specific crossover operator and feasibility function has been developed. Effectiveness of the proposed meta-heuristic algorithm is tested on the random graphs generated using NetworkX Erdős-Rényi model, a popular model for graph generation. Experimental results show that the proposed genetic algorithm for solving MRTDP gives a near optimal solution in reasonable time.

articleTitle: MSViT: A video anomaly detection for real time unconstrained environment
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: Most of the previously proposed approaches are either based on CNN or transformer. CNN due to its spatial inductive bias can only learn the local representation whereas due to the absence of this property, the transformer-based approaches can learn only the global representation. Thus, the approaches based on these techniques are generally heavy as they required deeper and wider layers to learn visual representation. In addition, these approaches are mainly designed for the constrained environment. In this paper, we proposed the novel approach MSViT using MobileNet and a transformer that can extract both the local and global features from the incoming frames. Our approach is light, and shallow and can detect the video abnormal activities in both the constrained and unconstrained environment in real-time with high accuracy. The abnormal object recognized by our approach is further detected and tracked using the YOLO and DeepSORT algorithms. For the evaluation, we used our custom unconstrained environment dataset GEU and for the comparison, we used constrained environment dataset Ped1, Ped2, CUHK Avenue, and ShanghaiTech for which we obtain AUC of 97.58%, 97.21%, 94.32%, and 95.56% and EER of 3.25%, 3.49%, 6.8%, and 8.25% respectively. Our approach has an average running time of 0.00785 (127 FPS).

articleTitle: Implementation of SC-FDE waveform on SDRP Using Vitis HLS
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: High Level Synthesis (HLS) tools give designers a time-efficient platform to develop the best design solution by exploring multiple design alternatives without a detailed understanding of hardware. In this work, hardware implementation of Single Carrier Frequency Domain Equalization (SC-FDE) waveform on software-defined radio (SDR) using Vitis HLS is presented. The SC-FDE waveform is implemented on an FPGA-based software-defined radio platform (SDRP). In this platform, Xilinx Virtex-7 FPGA is used as the main processing device to implement modulation, demodulation, synchronization, and Maximal Ration Combining (MRC) functionalities, and AD9364 transceiver is used for baseband to RF conversion. The waveform has been tested for AWGN and fading channels using the Channel Emulator. Resource utilization of HLS-generated IPs and performance of waveform is presented in terms of throughput and SNR with different channel conditions. Furthermore, the performance of this waveform with Xilinx LDPC IP is also presented. We have also validated waveform in the real scenarios by over-the-air transmission. The maximum throughput of 29 Mbps is achieved with this waveform.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of CZTS Solar Cell with ZnS+ZnMgO as a Buffer layer using SCAPS-1D
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: CZTS (copper zinc tin sulfide) photovoltaic cells are a type of thin-film solar cell that has recently gained attention as a potential alternative to traditional silicon-based solar cells. CZTS solar cells are made of earth-abundant and low-cost materials and have demonstrated high efficiency in converting sunlight into electricity. In order to create a hybrid buffer layer of ZnS and ZnMgO for the ZnO:Al/ZnS+ZnMgO/CZTS solar cell structure, ZnS is used in this work as a substitute for ZnO. The SCAPS-1D tool has been used to simulate the effects of the hybrid buffer layer (ZnS+ZnMgO) and Cu<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>ZnSnS<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf>(CZTS) absorber layer that make up the solar cell. Our solar cell performs best at 1.4 eV of CZTS band gap energy and 3.2 μm of thickness. After replacing ZnO with ZnS, the acquired results characteristics including Voc, Jsc, FF, and PCE saw considerable changes. The reported power conversion efficiency before replacement is 21.84% and after replacement of ZnO to ZnS, the obtained power conversion efficiency is 23.00%. Further the performance parameters of ZnO:Al/ZnS+ZnMgO/CZTS cells have been investigated for different thickness and operating temperatures.

articleTitle: Image Spam detection in E-mails using Grasshoppers optimization technique
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: one of the most frequent types of digital communication is email. Spam is unsolicited mass mail, whereas image spam includes spam text incorporated in images. This type of spam threatens email communications because spammers use it to avoid text spam filters. This paper provides a support vector machine (SVM) based classification algorithm and a biology optimization strategy to categorize emails as spam or ham. In this study, we examine image spam detection strategies using different combinations of image processing and machine learning algorithms. The grasshopper optimization algorithm (GOA) is an approach that statistically models and simulates the behavior of natural locust swarms. We investigate and analyze the performance of Grasshopper optimizations using several evaluation measures, such as accuracy, precision, recall, f1-score, and convergence rate to the global optimum solution.

articleTitle: Precise Multiplier Design using Novel 4:2 Compressor
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: This paper proposes a novel 4:2 compressor, which is energy efficient than the existing compressors. The proposed compressor is 36% energy efficient the conventional compressor. The proposed compressor is used in the partial product reduction stage of the Dadda Multiplier. It is observed that 8-bit multiplier design is 26.72% efficient than the existing compressor based multiplier design.

articleTitle: Power and Area Aware Bump Physically Unclonable Function
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: In design of integrated circuits, process variations are a serious problem. This has been used to develop a novel hardware security primitive or digital fingerprint generator, called a Bump Physical Unclonable Function (BPUF), for resource-constrained low-power applications. The proposed architecture uses only five transistors as PUF cell, and minimum peripheral circuitry, making it compact and suited for resource-constrained applications. The simulation results reveal that the proposed design uses 35.71fJ/bit of energy, and has 0.0045µm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> of area per bit, and has near equal probability of 1s and 0s, with a uniformity of 61.06%. The median, as determined by the inter Hamming Distance (HD) plot, is 48.33%, which is very close to the golden mean of 50%. This demonstrates that the suggested PUF can reliably produce single-use tokens.

articleTitle: Design of 2.4 GHz LNA Using Microstrip Narrow Band Pass Filter
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: RF amplifier is a device that has vital effect on the all-round efficiency and operation of a communication system. LNA is the vital component in the front end of receiver chain. To improve the noise performance of the receiver, it is important to design LNA for optimum noise figure. In this paper, a 2.4 GHz single band LNA is designed using proposed novel input matching scheme. Input matching network is designed using narrow band pass filter with microstrip transmission lines. The design uses the transistor ATF-36077 HEMT device and RT-Duroid 5880 substrate. Simulation of the design is carried out in Advance Design System-ADS tool. The proposed design is unconditionally stable in the band of interest. It reports forward gain S21 of 10.923 dB and noise figure of 2.895 dB. The input return loss S11 and the output return loss S22 are observed as -19.260 dB and -18.155 dB respectively. The power consumption of the proposed circuit is 12mW, for the supply voltage of 1.5 V.

articleTitle: Intelligent Traffic Monitoring and Management System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: The aim of the Intelligent Monitoring and Management System (ITMMS) is to increase road safety by monitoring measures. It is one of the major building blocks of an Advanced Traffic Management System. This system is incorporated the following features such as a user-friendly human machine interface, a dashboard to configure, visualize, and analyze traffic patterns, to monitor and manage a network of C-DAC adaptive traffic signal controllers installed at different junctions, a User Management System, a centralized junction configuration module and control traffic signals remotely. It has monitoring features in different visual formats such as trends, charts, reports, and live animation screens. The user management system provides user based alarms, and user specific authorization to access different software modules. The centralized junction configuration tool facilitates plan download, and upload functionality to configure the junctions remotely. Also, it receives online junction patterns periodically from different junction controllers, and the same will be distributed to associated software modules for display, reporting and processing by the Adaptive Traffic Control System Composite Signal Control Strategy.

articleTitle: Application of Liquid Crystal in the Design of Memory and Thermistor
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: In this work, a thermotropic liquid crystal is synthesized using 4 - butyl benzoic acid and dodecyloxy benzoic acid. This hydrogen bonded liquid crystal exhibiting nematic phase is found to exhibit thermistor characteristics and memory storage. Dielectric studies are done to find out the frequency at which the maximum data can be stored. The effect of various parameters like temperature and electric field on the liquid crystal are elucidated. The hysteresis loop is recorded by varying the field whose area corresponds to the maximum storage capacity of the device which is also mapped in terms of the bytes. The observance of dynamic memory effect in an undoped liquid crystal and the usage of the same as the thermistor with negative temperature coefficient is the main idea behind this work.

articleTitle: Optimal design of an off-grid hybrid system using HOMER Pro
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: The shift towards the green power technology has been increasing rapidly because renewable resources provide pollution free energy. HOMER Pro is employed for the optimal designing of off-grid hybrid renewable energy system (HRES) which has solar, wind and battery with a conventional energy source. The design criteria of this paper are to reduce the cost of energy and increase the renewable fraction. It has been observed that PV/WT/DG/ES/Converter is the optimal configuration which contains 484 kW PV, 972 kW WT, 480 kW DG, 1356 kW ES and 375 kW converter. This scenario generates the least COE of 0.282 $/kWh and dump power 806257 kWh with zero unmet load. A brief analysis of optimal combination of HRES has been carried out.

articleTitle: Sequential Transfer Learning Models with Additional Layers for Pneumonia Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: Pneumonia is a disease caused by numerous microorganisms affecting the alveoli sac of the lungs, filling them with pleural fluid. It affects many children and adults and can be fatal to them, hence early identification is essential. X-ray is a non-invasive and cheapest method available for the diagnosis of pneumonia. For this study, the impact of custom sequential models with additional layers for pneumonia diagnosis was investigated. The research used a dataset of 5856 X-ray images from the Kermany dataset to train deep learning models for computer-aided diagnosis of pneumonia. Transfer learning was employed with pre-trained classifiers, and the results were compared between a basic approach of using only a classification layer on extracted features and a second approach that involved adding additional layers after the pre-trained classifiers. The performance of the deep learning models was evaluated using accuracy, precision, specificity, recall, F1 score, and ROC curve. The results showed that the second approach, which included additional layers, led to an increase in the AUC of all classifiers. The Vgg16 model performed particularly well, displaying an F1 score of 89.61%.

articleTitle: Spectral Efficiency of Different Diversity Combiners Under Log-Normal Shadowing Channels- A Review
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: This paper evaluates the Channel capacity under log-normal condition. The channel capacity is evaluated using Optimum Rate Adaptation under constant transmit power (ORA). Closed form expression for ORA was evaluated under No-Branch Diversity and M-Branch Diversity using Maximal Ratio Combining (MRC) and Equal Gain Combining (EGC). Fenton’s Method was used to evaluate expression of mean and standard deviation of instantaneous Signal to Noise Ratio (SNR) for MRC and EGC combiner under log-normal shadowing.

articleTitle: Modeling of Thermoelectric Module for Generating Power
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: Thermoelectric technology is based on the conversion of a temperature difference into electrical energy, or vice versa, using thermoelectric modules. Thermoelectric modules can be used as substitute to traditional methods of cooling and heating. In this study mathematical model of thermoelectric module is developed to estimate electrical behavior of thermoelectric module with changing conditions of hot side temperature and ambient temperature. The electrical behavior of the thermoelectric module needs to be modeled to understand the electrical power output and efficiency of the device. Mathematical model of thermoelectric module is developed using MATLAB software for various thermoelectric materials using their thermoelectric properties. The performance of thermoelectric model for various thermoelectric material is compared. This model takes thermal parameters including hot side temperature and cold side temperature as input parameters and provides the electrical parameters including generated power, current and voltage as output parameters. It is found that the thermoelectric module made up of bismuth telluride material generates more power and also has good conversion efficiency than lead and ferrous based alloys.

articleTitle: Social Distancing Detection AI System using YOLO
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: The number of reported COVID-19 cases has once again increased due to the recent spread of the H3N2 virus. Even with vaccinations and medications, social distancing remains the most effective way to prevent the spread of these viruses. To address this issue, this paper proposes an automated system for monitoring social distancing in public places. The system utilizes a YOLOv3 object detection model to detect pedestrians in video frames captured by a camera.
