publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: This paper provides a conceptual analysis of "Last-Mile Connectivity" in aspects of internet connectivity, exploring the limitations and challenges which can arise in the delivery of internet services to the end-users. This work elaborates on the importance and necessity of effective communication. It provides a brief overview of how the last-mile connectivity of a communication network can be a bottleneck that limits the amount of data that can be delivered to end-users, mainly in rural and remote areas. By adopting the analogy of the daily transport system, this work illustrates the concept of last-mile connectivity and its interconnections with the backbone network. In addition, this paper examines the current state of last-mile connectivity in India, where many areas still struggle to access reliable internet services. Overall, the article provides valuable insights into the complex and challenging issue of last-mile connectivity and its impact on internet connectivity for end-users.

articleTitle: A solar tracking system with light-dependent resistors and a stepper motor controlled by a microcontroller
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: Solar energy is a clean and simple method of electricity generation. This electricity is utilized for various purposes, ranging from modest electrical gadgets and cars to major enterprises, satellites, and space exploration. The title of this project, "Solar tracking system with light-dependent resistors and a stepper motor controlled by a microcontroller" alludes to the project’s purpose, which is to harvest as much solar energy as possible from a solar panel throughout the day using a specific Sun tracking mechanism. To do this, a mechanism was developed that tracks the sun’s position and rotates the solar panel correspondingly so that it receives maximum sunlight at all times of the day. This is accomplished by mounting a stepper motor and a couple of light-dependent resistors (LDRs) on the solar panel, which adjusts its orientation based on the location of the sun. This project has three primary components: the solar panel, the stepper motor, and the LDRs. Microcontroller, sensor, and stepper motor. For this aim, an Arduino UNO microcontroller has been utilized. It accepts an output signal from a sensor as input, processes it, and controls stepper motors based on the supplied program. A stepper motor is attached to the shaft on which a panel is positioned to raise and lower the panel. Since maximal solar rays always strike the surface of the solar panel module, it is possible to obtain maximum power output, increasing its total efficiency as compared to the static panel.

articleTitle: High Efficient High Power Factor Single phase LED Driver with Constant Output Current without Electrolytic Capacitor*
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: In this paper, an LED driver based on a two-port design is discussed. Minimal power processing (MPP) can be achieved by controlling the flow of power, thus reducing the dependence on storage capacitance and improving the lifespan of the driver. Unlike cascaded LED drivers, the DC-DC converter only needs to handle a part of the input power in this design. This will improve the driver’s overall efficiency. By adjusting the input-side filter, the ripple power is reduced on the AC side. With this design, the electrolytic capacitor can be removed, increasing the lifespan of the driver. A 30 W PSIM simulation model is built, and results are verified. The results demonstrated that the proposed driver achieved a power factor of 0.99 with low input current harmonics and a peak efficiency of 97% at full power with peak-to-peak output current ripple of 3.03%.

articleTitle: Building an automated model to predict and detect early onset osteoarthritis
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: This research targets the need to provide early detection of osteoarthritis to assist the ongoing global effort to make treatment of this disease viable and effective. With regards to the rapid degradation of the condition, it is critical to detect it early enough so that suppressive treatment can reduce symptoms and progression. Using an approach of automation via efficient data analysis, it is possible to detect arthritis quite early in a patient’s diagnostics. This paper aims to provide both a statistical and a more direct approach to the determination of the probability of osteoarthritis at early onset to improve the odds for a patient. The system will take primary variables from a patient's file and look for patterns matching cases in the dataset it was trained against. The dataset for the same has been taken from the NIH archive for academic purposes.

articleTitle: Neural Network-Based Prediction of Feedback Gain Parameters in Networked Control System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: The main challenges which are being faced by the networked control system (NCS) are transmission delays and vacant sampling. This paper proposes a method to design an intelligent feedback controller based on an artificial neural network(ANN) for a networked control system while stability is set as a performance criterion. This proposed controller does an accurate estimation of feedback gain parameters for the random network delay. There is a very thin range of feedback gain parameters that ensure stability in the system concerning each random value of network time delay that may be within the sampling interval and beyond the sampling interval. This paper suggests ANN based learning mechanism to make a networked control system stable in the presence of random delay. The predicted feedback gain parameters with the learning mechanism ensure the NCS stable. Simulation results in MATLAB ensure stability in the loop of the networked control system.

articleTitle: Design and Performance Analysis of Defected Grounded Hexagonal Patch Antenna at 5.17 GHz
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: A defected grounded hexagonal patch antenna tuned at 5.17 GHz is designed in this manuscript. This antenna has reflection coefficient of -39.41 dB at its resonant frequency. It provides a fractional bandwidth of 22.97% around 5.17 GHz and it radiates over wide frequency range of 4.66 GHz to 5.85 GHz. This antenna possesses 1.63 dBi realized gain at its resonant frequency. Fabrication of this antenna has performed in this work to validate the simulated results. The resonant frequency of the fabricated antenna is observed as 5.10 GHz and its return loss value is 13.20 dB at this frequency. Comparing simulated and measured result, it is observed that these results slightly differ due to fabrication error. This antenna can be used for aeronautical radio-navigation and wireless communications. Due to presence of defected ground plane, back lobe is present in far field pattern of this antenna. Therefore, a metal reflector has been placed at a certain distance from the ground plane in the back side of the antenna.

articleTitle: An Approach of Cable Sheath Bonding for Critical Airport Application
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: Single-point bonding is a commonly used cable sheath technique as it possesses high cable ampacity. This bonding scheme is associated with a grounding continuity conductor. This in turn contributes to significant cost while implementing the setup. This paper proposes a 66kV sheath bonding scheme that is deployed on a real-time critical airport application. This proposed scheme has optimal maximum voltage induced at sheath which was grounded using sheath voltage limits (SVL) at proper interval which contributes in realizing a stable system.

articleTitle: Design of an 8-Elements DGS based Dual Band MIMO Antenna with Improved Isolation for Wireless Communications
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)

authors.preferredName: Dinavahi B N V Sai Durga Sri Raja Ram
authors.firstName: Dinavahi B N V Sai Durga Sri Raja

abstract: A dual band 8-elements MIMO (Multiple Input Multiple Output) antenna design is proposed in this paper. Microstrip patch and defected ground structure (DGS) have been incorporated to obtain two frequencies at 2.4 GHz (Wi-Fi) and 3.6 GHz (Wi-MAX) respectively. The values of gain at the resonant frequencies for proposed MIMO are achieved as 1.7 dB and 1.5 dB respectively. The total dimension of the 8-elements MIMO antenna is 0.992λ × 0.528λ (λ is wavelength in free-space calculated at lowest resonant frequency) which ensures that the overall 8-elements MIMO is very compact in size. The isolation between side-by-side antenna elements is improved by using T-shaped stubs thereby keeping the isolation values below -20 dB at the resonant frequencies. The values of envelop correlation coefficient (ECC) for all pair of antennas are less than 0.002 and diversity gain (DG) values are almost equal to 10 dB for overall bandwidth. The channel capacity loss (CCL) values at the resonating frequencies are nearly equal to 0.02. The proposed MIMO antenna is a good candidate in terms of scattering parameter, gain and diversity performances for practical wireless applications.

articleTitle: Revolutionizing rural electrification with PV Integrated energy storage system: The DC House Solution
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: Given a wide range of problems in rural setup, the electricity storage and its grid-integration pose major bottlenecks in rural areas with limitations in generation and supply of electrical power. DC House technology can significantly improve the usage of sources of clean energy for power generation. This paper explains the proposed energy management strategy involving maximum power point tracking (MPPT) with Incremental Conductance algorithm and the voltage droop control strategy. This scheme promises judicious power distribution within the source components and enhances the dependability and consistency level of the DC House. With this approach, DC loads are directly powered by a low-power, low voltage DC electrical system, enabling scalability, affordability, and flexibility. This controller strategy was designed by synchronising PV generation and demand of load, ensuring quicker DC link voltage in MATLAB/Simulink.

articleTitle: Improved Speech Recognition using Vector Quantization, Genetic Algorithm and Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: Speech recognition has long been one of the most difficult and active research problems in Artificial Intelligence (AI). Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) finds applications in the field of military, transportation, healthcare, electronic systems and many more. This technology enables humans to communicate with a computer interface in a manner that resembles normal human conversation. This paper proposes an improved automatic speech recognition using Vector Quantization, Genetic Algorithms and Neural Networks. A genetic algorithm is used for feature selection from an ordered set of speech data generated using vector quantization. The neural network further is used for the recognition of speech data. For validation of the improved method data is collected in which a line is spoken in five languages by 25 speakers. Experimental results demonstrate that the improved method achieves 93% accuracy with the minimum number of features.

articleTitle: Application of canopy clustering for categorization of states based on crime against children
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: Crimes on children may take place from home to school or online or anyplace. In recent times, there is a rise in crimes against children aided by digital technology, such as online sexual exploitation, sextortion and cyberbullying. These forms of crimes can spread to huge audience or can go unreported by parents & care takers and hence these can be mostly dangerous. Although the crime data merely covers the number of crime cases reported during several years in all states, cluster approach can be applied to group states in India based on rate of crime cases against children. In this paper, canopy cluster methodology is applied in WEKA platform to find trends & patterns in crime data and categorize all Indian states depend on crime cases against children which may help to build effective interventions to mitigate and control crimes against children.

articleTitle: Indigenous Development of Water Quality Monitoring System for Urban Areas using IoT & ML
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: Issues related to water quality in urban areas are caused by human activities like industrialization, urbanization, and population growth, which lead to pollution of water sources. As a result, monitoring water quality in urban areas is crucial, and this has been accomplished via a system that employs Internet of Things (IoT) and Machine Learning (ML) approaches. This paper analyses water properties and predicts if the water is safe to consume. The TDS & turbidity sensors are dipped in different water samples collected from tanks, submersibles, water towers, underground water, & other places, which helps to receive data in real-time. The information is first updated in the Arduino IDE before being uploaded to a cloud server. This real-time data is tested & validated on the model designed using different ML models like Support Vector Machine, Random Forest, and Extreme Gradient Boost. The maximum accuracy achieved using XGBoost is 96.12%. After testing, we will be able to establish whether the water is safe to drink by utilising binary indicators of 1 and 0, where 1 indicates that the water is safe to drink and 0 indicates that it is not.

articleTitle: Efficient condition monitoring of off shore wind turbines using deep networks
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: The wind turbines (WT) are installed both onshore and offshore. The offshore WTs are more productive as compared to the onshore WTs as the availability of the wind speed is much higher offshore, but this productivity comes at the cost of an increase in faults, a higher maintenance requirement, and difficulty in accessibility. It is very difficult to gather the signatures with invasive sensors from the offshore WT due to the surrounding conditions. The position of the sensors changes, leading to unreliable signatures. A non-invasive sensor-based infrared thermography technique has been proposed to solve this problem. In this work, an approach for non-invasive condition monitoring of offshore WT for inter-turn short circuit (ITSC) faults has been developed using deep neural network (DNN)-based features of thermograms. Pre-trained deep learning (DL) models such as Alex Net have frequently been used for the diagnosis of motor faults. These pre-trained DL models are tested on particular data, which has a different classification problem and does not provide a reliable and high-efficacy model. Along with the previous drawback, these models also suffer from high processing times. To solve these problems, in this work, pre-trained models are modified with the incorporation of the feature selection technique and a shallow learning classifier at the output layer. The proposed methodology is able to classify the ITSC, rotor, and cooling fan faults with an accuracy of 99.7%.

articleTitle: High Gain Active Switched Inductor Nonisolated Z Source Based DC to DC Converter Topology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: A DC to DC converter with a high voltage gain is necessary to enhance the power output of fuel cell and solar panel installations. This paper discusses a novel, non-isolated, high-gain, and highly efficient active switched inductor impedance source-based DC-to-DC converter. The suggested converter exhibits a high voltage gain at a low duty ratio. All three switches in the converter operate at the same switching frequency and duty ratio, making the control scheme remarkably simple. A comprehensive analysis of the converter’s continuous conduction mode steady state is provided. To validate the functionality of the recommended converter, simulations are conducted using MATLAB. The simulations are performed with an input voltage, V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">in</inf>, of 10V, a switching frequency, f<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">s</inf>, of 100kHz, and a fixed duty ratio, δ, of 0.4. The simulation outputs are presented to demonstrate the performance characteristics of the proposed converter. With an input voltage of 10V, the output voltage is measured at 120V, resulting in a calculated gain of 12 for the proposed converter.

articleTitle: Optical Biosensor for Early Diagnosis of Cancer
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: Cancer survivors are increasing due to scientific enhancement in diagnosis methodologies. Early diagnosis plays a major role in cancer treatment. Optical biosensors are real-time, fast, portable, highly sensitive and effectively detect cancer in the human body. A fiber optic evanescent wave (FOEW) sensor with two-dimensional (2D) absorption-enhancing layer of graphene is proposed and simulated for performance analysis. The different chalcogenide materials (Se<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">95</inf>Te<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</inf>Sm<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.25</inf>, As<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">40</inf>Se<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">60</inf>, and Ge<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">20</inf>Ga<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</inf>Sb<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">10</inf>S<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">65</inf> (2S2G) respectively ) are investigated in terms of sensitivity and resolution in near-infrared (NIR) region for discrimination of malignancy in human liver tissue. A monolayer of graphene is considered atop of reduced clad to enhance the evanescent interaction with analyte. The analysis reveals that with a maximum sensitivity of 46.8 mW/RIU and higher resolution of 2.1×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-9</sup> RIU, the 2S2G chalcogenide glass material provides best optimum detection accuracy compared with other glass materials.

articleTitle: Jelly Bot: Revolutionizing Beach Safety
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: Drowning is a major problem in most of the world. It is the 3rd leading cause of accidental demise globally and accounts for 7% of all injury deaths. There are approximately 236000 deaths worldwide every year due to drowning, but it is still believed that this number underestimates the actual public health problem associated with drowning. This paper proposes a solution to address this issue by introducing autonomous Jelly Bots equipped with drowning detection capabilities for deployment in high-risk areas such as beaches and ghats. The Jelly Bot offers improved rescue capabilities in uncertain situations and is computationally efficient. The proposed model utilizes a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) for real-time video analysis to identify drowning activity with high speed and accuracy. The implementation of underwater drones, visual surveillance, and search and rescue techniques contributes to enhancing beach safety and reducing drowning incidents.

articleTitle: Column Rotation Transpose Based PV Array Reconfiguration Method for Efficient Shade Dispersion under Mismatch Conditions
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: Partial shading is one of the biggest hindrances to the optimal functioning of photovoltaic (PV) systems. It impacts the peak power generation by the PV systems, and if not dealt properly then can be hazardous for the PV systems. It’s therefore important to mitigate this issue by adopting some reconfiguration techniques to effectively overcome the Partial shading conditions (PSCs). In this research study, a novel reconfiguration technique has been proposed to overcome the challenges caused by the PSC. The proposed reconfiguration technique effectively disperses the shading effect and improves the efficiency of the PV system. The proposed reconfiguration technique is applicable to symmetrical PV arrays of all sizes which makes it scalable. The performance of the proposed reconfiguration technique has been analyzed for various shade cases against different configurations. The outcome of this study shows that there is a significant improvement in performance as compared to the others.

articleTitle: Dual Band Notch and Dual Port MIMO Antenna with End Fire Radiation Pattern for UWB Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: In this paper a dual band notch Vivaldi Antenna (VA) with two port MIMO characteristics has been presented for Ultrawideband (UWB) applications. Initially a vivaldi structured antenna has been investigated with the bandwidth of 153%, which is more than UWB, formally known as Super Wideband (SWB). Further a complimentary split ring resonator (C-SRR) has been etched out to create a band notch in C-Band and another stub has been added in the close proximity of the feedline to create the band notch in X-band. Proposed structure further investigated with the MIMO capabilities for two ports and observed results are satisfying the criteria for MIMO applications. The proposed design has been realized physically and tested in the laboratory. Results of simulation and measurements are matching closely that can be well suited for modern wireless communication systems.

articleTitle: Dynamic modelling, Design and experimental analysis of closed loop controlled Zeta Converter using OPAL-RT
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: A zeta converter is a fourth-order DC-DC converter that may operate in either step-up or step-down mode. It consists of two inductors and two capacitors. In this study, a Zeta converter is dynamically modelled, controlled, and experimentally validated. Its transfer functions have been derived using the State-Space Averaging. The DPSO optimised PI controller is made to manage the output voltage based on the deduced control-to-output transfer function. The results show good steady state and load shift performance of the converter. Using the MATLAB environment, the open loop and closed loop Zeta converter’s performance and stability are analysed. The experimental validation is done in addition to the performance validation using OPAL RT.

articleTitle: A Grid Connected Multilevel Inverter With Improved Reliability and Fault Tolerant Capability
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: The multilevel inverters are less reliable than two-level inverters as it require more semiconductor devices. Hence, this work proposes a grid connected fault-tolerant five level inverter (FT5LI) that can endure the switch open-circuit fault. The proposed FT5LI generate 5L voltage during normal operation, and can able to produce either five, three or two level voltages during any switch open circuit fault. Further, the switching strategy for the proposed FT5LI is comprehensively detailed alongside fault-tolerant operation schematics. In addition, several simulation results are shown to verify the reliability of the proposed FT5LI during normal, fault, and post-fault settings to confirm the proposed concepts.

articleTitle: MARG-DARSHAK: A Machine Learning Approach for Career Prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: Choosing a suitable career is one of the most crucial decisions, and with the growing number of career options and opportunities, it has become quite challenging for job seekers to make this decision. However, available resources, such as career counsellors, are often limited in number and costly, making it difficult for all students to access them. To address this issue, we propose a career prediction model that utilizes three machine learning algorithms, namely KNN, SVM, and SGD. After conducting experiments on a dataset, we found that SVM outperforms the other two classifiers with an accuracy of 99.62

articleTitle: Performance Analysis and Anomaly detection of Power Distribution Insulators using Deep Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: In the field of Machine Learning, Deep Learning(DL) is a rapidly growing area and it uses Convolutional Neural Networks(CNN) for image classification as it gives the most accurate results. CNN has various pre-trained architectures available for every type of problem. A variety of insulator parts with various forms and construction materials are found in the overhead power transmission lines. These Electrical assets are continually exposed to environmental factors and operational circumstances, which could result in size, color, and structure variations. This work offers a reliable image classification methodology that seeks to identify insulator classes effectively regardless of the degree of degradation. Here, we used various classical classifiers and identified the insulator defect pieces. In order to use a previously trained CNN as a feature extractor for training new classifiers, it must first undergo a step of fine-tuning. To determine which type of classifier provided the best non-conforming component discrimination performance, a comparison study was done.By identifying non-conforming component classes with an overall accuracy of 96%, the suggested methodology significantly improved classification performance.

articleTitle: Key-Frame based Video Summarization using Optimized K-means Clustering
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: Video content has been increasing at a very high pace, so summarizing videos is of urgent need. Video summa-rization emphasizes the quick go-through of video content. In the past decades, the field of video summarization has attracted a lot of research. Many of the techniques have been proposed by different researchers. However, most of them are not able to create summaries of general videos, i.e., they are generally good for a set of a category of videos. So, to solve this problem, we have proposed a deep feature-based clustering framework for video summarization. We have used the pre-trained resnet151v2 model for feature extraction, and based on the extracted features, we group the frames of the video using the K-means clustering algorithm. After that, we selected the central frame from each video cluster and finally combined them to form the video summary. The experiments were performed on different types of videos taken from the different datasets and the results show that the proposed methodology performs better compared to some existing video summarization techniques.

articleTitle: Intelligent Course Recommendation for Higher Education based on Learner Proficiency
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: A course recommendation provides valuable guidance and support to learners navigating their educational and career journeys. Artificial Intelligence paves the way for recommending higher education courses. In this article, a framework is proposed that uses different features like learners’ interest, their past performance and mainly their family talent history. This framework emphasizes the Intelligence Robotic Course Recommendation System. The system is very helpful for the learner who don’t have that much of an explorer of the current trends happening in the world. When the learners similarity knowledge interest is known with respect to real-world needs, the perfect higher education is suggested for them. This paper shows that the framework gives better results when using with artificial intelligence algorithms.

articleTitle: A Novel Perspective on Brain Tumor Classification Using Hybrid Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: Brain tumor classification is a critical task in medical imaging, where the early and accurate detection of brain tumors is crucial for patient treatment and survival. In recent years, Machine Learning techniques have emerged as a promising approach for automated brain tumor classification. In this paper, we investigate the performance of three ML classifiers – Support Vector Machine, Naïve Bayes, and an ensemble of SVM and Naïve Bayes – for the two-class classification of brain tumor data into a tumor and no tumor classes. Our experiments demonstrate that the ensemble of SVM and Naïve Bayes classifier achieved an accuracy of 97% outperforming the other classifiers. These results indicate that our ensemble classifier can be a powerful tool for the accurate and efficient classification of brain tumor data, potentially leading to improved patient outcomes.

articleTitle: Studies on Input DC and output AC Current of 1-Phase Inverter for Unipolar and Bipolar Switching
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: Single Phase Inverter along with a 12V, 220Ah battery has been used by millions of households, thus switching topologies and its effects on the battery performance needs to be analyzed and studied. In this paper, performance of the single phase inverter with 180 degree switching (i.e. square wave output), sinusoidal pulse width modulation (SPWM) with bipolar and unipolar switching techniques has been analyzed. The input DC current and the output AC current for the various switching techniques has been compared on the basis of percentage of harmonics. Matlab R2022a software has been used to obtain the harmonic spectrums. The fundamental components and total harmonic distortion (THD) of input current waveform, output current and voltage waveform using various techniques has been presented as well as tabulated. SPWM with unipolar switching results in low THD output voltage and high efficiency, but at the cost of polluting the DC supply current with higher percentage of harmonics compared to bipolar and 180 degree switching.

articleTitle: A Novel Six-Level Inverter with Reduce Number of Components for Five-Phase Open-End Winding Induction Motor Drive
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: This paper proposes a novel six-level inverter five phase open-end winding induction motor (OEWIM) drive. This topology utilizes a combination of a 3-level, 5-phase inverter and a 2-level, 5-phase inverter to achieve a 6-level, 5-phase inversion operation. Neutral point clamped (NPC) six-level five-phase inverter which requires 50 switches, 5 DC bus capacitors and 40 neutral point clamped diode, Similarly, the flying capacitor (FC) six-level five-phase inverter topology requires 50 switches, 5 DC bus capacitors and 40 flying capacitors while the proposed topology requires only 30 switches and 3 DC voltage sources. The proposed topology reduces the component count which reduces control complexity and switching losses of the inverter. Five-phase OEWIM drives have several advantages like improved torque ripple and speed performance during load variation, transient response etc. as compared to three-phase OEWIM drives. Additionally, the increased number of phases allows for higher power delivery, making the proposed topology suitable for high-powered drives. The performance of the inverter is evaluated using level-shifted pulse width modulation (LSPWM) and validated through simulations in the MATLAB/Simulink environment.

articleTitle: Breaking Down Data Silos: Data Mesh to Achieve Effective Aggregation in Data Localization
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: Data localization laws are becoming more common, which makes it hard for companies to manage and combine data that is spread out in different parts of the world. This is especially hard because data is scattered and there are limits on how data can be sent across borders. Data Mesh, a new way of thinking about data architecture, offers a solution to this problem by offering a decentralized way of managing data that can make it easier to put together data in a local context. In this paper, we discuss the problems that organizations face when trying to manage data localization with respect to the data regulations in different regions, the problems with traditional approaches to data management, and the benefits of using a data mesh architecture to gather data. We also discuss a region-based unified data mesh architecture that was made with data localization in mind, pointing out its most important parts and benefits. Our proposed unified data mesh abstraction model can help organizations to deal with the problems caused by data localization and use their data assets to make better decisions and get better insights.

articleTitle: Implementation and optimization of Deep learning models for Musculoskeletal image classification for detection of Osteoporosis
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: Injuries related to joints, bones, muscles, and spine can be cured as the Musculoskeletal Radiographs have an advantage over other way of treatment. So AI can be better approach in categorizing Radiographs from an X-ray of various bones of body as fractured & non-fractured.A total of five DL oriented pre trained models’ performance were taken into consideration for detecting these fractures using MURA dataset provided by Standford University Group, and ensemble modelling was used for every category that resulted in better accuracies in some classes of dataset. InceptionV3, Mobile-NetV2, ResNet-101, VGG-16 and VGG-19 models were employed. In the ensemble modelling approach, training, testing accuracies & Cohen’s Kappa values were taken into consideration.

articleTitle: New predefined-time sliding mode controller for synchronization of non-identical hyperchaotic systems
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: This report presents synchronization of two nonidentical hyperchaotic systems by using sliding mode controller based on the concept of predefined-time stability. The two chaotic systems used for synchronization are topologically different from each other. A self-excited hyperchaotic system with dissipative nature is selected as the master system and a hidden hyperchaotic system with conservative nature is selected as the slave system. Sliding mode control is an effective tool to achieve synchronization in chaotic systems. However, it suffers from asymptotic convergence as well dependency on the initial conditions. Thereby, a new predefined-time sliding mode controller is used to synchronize the non-identical hyperchaotic systems. The designed controller does the task of synchronization within a pre-assigned time and its convergence is independent of initial conditions. In addition, the controller shows robustness against external disturbances and parameter uncertainties. Simulation results are obtained in MATLAB environment which reveals the successful implementation of the designed controller.

articleTitle: Numerical Simulation of Inverted Hybrid Perovskite Solar Cell
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: The article demonstrate the study of numerical simulation for an inverted hybrid Perovskite Solar Cell (PSC) with a device arrangement i.e. FTO/CuSCN/MAPbI<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>/PCBM/SnO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>/Pt, where, CH<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>NH<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>PbI<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> is used as an absorber (perovskite) layer, PCBM is used as ETL (Electron Transport Layer), CuSCN is incorporated as HTL (Hole Transport Layer) and SnO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> is employed as a buffer layer. This paper highlights the optimization and detailed systematic analysis performed to inspect the impact of variation in defect-density (N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">t</inf>), thickness, functional temperature, and acceptor density (N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">A</inf>) on the performance of inverted hybrid PSC by incorporation of SCAPS-1D solar simulator tool. This paper reports the highest Power Conversion Efficiency (PCE) of 20.69% at 300 K for the inverted hybrid PSC numerical simulation with the N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">t</inf> of 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">15</sup> cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup> and thickness of 600 nm.

articleTitle: Comparative Performance Analysis of Modern Digital Filters for Power Quality Improvement Using Distributed Static Compensator (DSTATCOM)
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: This study emphasizes on the comparison of two different types of modern digital filters viz Delay signal cancellation-Phase Lock Loop (DSC-PLL) and voltage-controlled oscillator (VCO) less PLL control for active shunt compensation. These digital filters are designed to gauge the extraction of the fundamental components of the nonlinear load current (I<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">L</inf>) drawn by the non-linear load (R-L) which further gets added to the output of DC voltage (V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">DC</inf>) PI (proportional-integrator) controller which is also considered to be the loss component (I<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">loss</inf>) of DSTATCOM which helps in estimating of the amplitude of active power component reference supply current (I<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">ref</inf>).The working of Delay signal cancellation-Phase lock loop (DSC-PLL) is being compared to other digital filters such as VCO-less PLL filter. The delay signal cancellation-Phase lock loop (DSC-PLL) and VCO less PLL is being simulated in SIMULINK/MATLAB and their performance is being observed and analyzed experimentally also. Both these control techniques are tested to improve the power quality of the system in which the DSTATCOM is used for active shunt compensation. After an extensive simulation study along with the hardware results under various load conditions

articleTitle: Intelligent user interfaces for Industry 4.0: Improving workplace security by systematically applying machine learning and image processing to identify face mask usage
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: The word "expression" suggests intent. The term "express" can be connoted as implied or imputed within. An emotion might be just a glance at someone's face which denotes a reaction. Reaction brings expression. In other words, expressiveness by someone refers to the way of communicating one's feelings. According to research and surveys, humans use 55–57 percent of body languages, 38 percent of tones or tonal variations, and the rest as words to convey meanings in messages for communication. It is also a proven fact that a significant part of the expression is in the form of nonverbal communication. There is sufficient evidence in psychology, pharmacology, and other fields to justify the same. Humans generally communicate through verbal expressions in response to inputs received, which is essential for our daily lives. However, word meanings can sometimes be challenging to detect the purpose accurately thereby necessitating good face recognition. Therefore it would be prudent to have face recognition made automatically and also effectively. In the present study, a facial emotion detection system seems to work correctly. The paper combines A.I. with image processing for such detection. Here Face-recognition software may be able to show the emotions that were captured by a camera. This article offers features related to this detection that has a over 90% success rate. The COVID-19 pandemic redefined the safety protocols of industries necessitating strict adherence to ‘wearing face masks while at work’. The method shown in the paper can thus be used to ensure strict adherence by all employees in the new normal scenario evading any verbal instruction for such compliance.

articleTitle: Aspects of Enhancing Loop Band Width for FVF based LDO Regulators : An Intuitive Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: High band width (BW) and fast slewing are key to the faster time domain performance of the low drop-out (LDO) voltage regulators. Voltage buffers act as an essential stage in improving bandwidth (BW) and stability by moving the pole appearing at the gate of bulky pass transistor away from the operating band of interest. This method is traded off with the quiescent current requirement of an LDO in low power IoT applications, with a potential threat over the desired regulation owing to the low loop gain. In this context, the approaches of extending the BW with voltage buffers are explored, and analysed in comparison with the emerging technique such as: a voltage combiner. The theoretical intuitive analysis regarding the BW is formulated and a relative comparison of based on the simulation of output impedance is performed. Different topology of LDO designs are simulated in the 45nm CMOS technology for the BW investigations and additional design freedom provided by the combiner block is explained.

articleTitle: A new asymmetric inverter with minimum number of switch count
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: Multilevel inverters (MLI) have piqued the interest of researchers for both high-power as well as medium-power applications. However, a configuration with minimal devices seems to be in trend in hopes of boosting effectiveness and reliability. This article proposes a novel single-phase MLI structure to minimize the quantity of switching devices in the circuit while enhancing the output voltage level. The proposed system yields 13 levels at the output by incorporating three DC voltage sources and eight switches. To develop gating signals, the level-shifted pulse width modulation (LSPWM) technique is used. The effectiveness of the suggested topology is explored using MATLAB/Simulink with various parametric conditions.

articleTitle: Design and Evaluation of Hydrogen Based Fuel Cell as a Green Energy Source
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: The proton exchange membrane fuel cell (PEMFC) serves high efficiency and works at low temperatures, which allows a fast start-up and produces only water as an end-product. Since PEMFC stacks are so expensive, it is hard to fully leverage or develop them for utilization. Hence, for successful implementation and optimized performance, modeling and simulations on software are necessary. In this paper, we have implemented a mathematical model of a PEMFC stack in MATLAB. In contrast to previously published models, this model is unique as fuel cell (FC) simulation and modeling can allow researchers to examine the effects of each parameter meticulously. Simulations have been executed on different load conditions using a PID controller on the FC. A PID controller has been used to further smooth out the waveforms. Further, to test the applicability of the FC, step-down converters have been implemented. A comparison has also been shown between a simple buck converter and a buck-boost converter.

articleTitle: Design of Memristor Based Controller for Speed Control of Induction Motor
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: In this article, a PID controller using a memristor is designed for speed control of an induction motor. The speed of an induction motor decreases as the load increase. The purpose of the developed memristor based PID controller is to eliminate the speed drop of an induction motor under the influence of a step load change. The root mean square error of the speed deviation is chosen as the objective function of the proposed memristor based controller. The performance of the developed controller is tested using simulation. The simulation study of the proposed induction motor controller is carried out in MATLAB/SIMULINK. The performance of the proposed controller is also compared to a conventional PID controller.

articleTitle: IoT based Solar Photo Voltaic Fault Detection System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: IoT enables exchanging data with other devices & systems over internet. It makes remote monitoring of Solar PV system simple and easy. This paper focuses on integration of IoT with solar panel to monitor them so as to detect faults in the panel easily, quickly and remotely. PV Monitoring is useful as it can increase life of protective devices and can help to isolate the faulty section from the healthy section of power system. PV system monitoring is accomplished by the use of sensors, Wi-Fi module, Arduino, microcontroller and display server. Arduino is used for programming. Once the data is uploaded on internet by Wi-Fi module and microcontroller, one has access to the parametric values obtained at the PV panel. The results are obtained on ThingSpeak server. The output is received in form of data of various parameters like PV voltage, temperature, humidity on ThingSpeak server in form of graphical representation. The paper presents an algorithm for fault detection and its display using temperature sensor and display server equipped in the IoT supported Solar PV system.

articleTitle: Cross Connected Five-Level Boosting Inverter with Self Voltage Balancing and Reduced Switch Count
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: Since multilevel inverters integrating switched capacitor units (SCMLIs) can boost output voltage and balance voltage across capacitors without requiring any additional balancing circuit, they have been an extensively discussed research area in power electronics for a while. The high voltage stress on the second-stage switches of two-stage boosting MLIs has remained a topic of concern in SCMLIs. This has prompted the development of several approaches to address the issue. Yet, the resulting integrated boosting MLI becomes more structurally complex. The single-stage boosting MLI for industrial applications illustrated in this work makes use of fewer switches, diodes, and capacitors. Eight switches, two diodes, and merely one capacitor are needed for five-level voltage generation. The proposed topology can implement multilevel inversion with boosted output voltage, a simplistic design, and a lesser number of power switches in comparison to its contemporaries. The switches are gated using a typical level-shifted pulse width modulation approach and the operating methodology of the proposed inverter is analyzed therewith. Also, a comparison with recent five-level inverter topologies is presented. Eventually, the outcomes of the simulation verify the efficacy of the suggested work.

articleTitle: Decision support system Application for recognition of alcoholic mental State from Epileptic EEG signals
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: New tools to decipher complicated systems can be found in the theory of nonlinear dynamic systems. Signal processing, analysis, and classification can all benefit from its novel ideas, algorithms, and techniques. The study of the dynamics of physiological signals now frequently employs these ideas. In this study, the authors use nonlinear dynamics theory to electroencephalogram (EEG) signals in an effort to better comprehend a wide range of mental processes. In this paper, we discuss an automated method for identifying sober and drunk EEG data based on their salient properties. Several aspects are employed in the extraction process. Various ranking procedures, including the t-test, the Wilcoxon test, and the Bhattacharyya technique, were applied to the retrieved features. Classifiers like the Support Vector Machine (SVM), the Decision Tree (DT), the K-Nearest Neighbour (KNN), and the Probabilistic Neural Network (PNN) are trained using the rated features (PNN). Based on the Bhattacharyya ranking technique, the SVM classifier using a radial basis function (RBF) achieves the highest classification accuracy (96.56 percent), sensitivity (95.29 percent), and specificity (97.81 percent) for the polynomial Kernel. This system can serve as a decision support tool for doctors making alcoholism diagnoses due to its speed, accuracy, and low cost. Rehabilitation centres can benefit greatly from this method of evaluating alcoholics over time and seeing how their brain changes respond to treatment.

articleTitle: Design and Realization of Fractional-order VM Biquad Filter using CFOA
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: This paper presents the active realization of a voltage mode fractional-order biquad filter which is capable of generating inverting low-pass, non-inverting band-pass along with a high-pass response. This filter has been realized using 3 current feedback operational amplifiers, 4 resistors and two fractional-capacitors of order α. The transfer function of the system is derived for all three responses. The stability of the suggested circuit is analyzed by employing the pole-zero plot in W-plane. The proposed circuit offers the independent frequency control feature by varying the order α. The average power consumption is calculated to be 0.22mW. The proposed circuit is simulated for various values of α using MATLAB and the transistor level simulation is carried out in LTSpice software using 180nm CMOS technology.

articleTitle: Dual-Layered Defence Mechanism For Prevention of XSS Attack
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: Over the years the usage of web applications has been increasing, and with the increase in usage and popularity comes security risks. Cross-site scripting attack is one such threat to web applications. Cross-site scripting also known as XSS is an attack wherein a malicious code is injected into a web application which leads to compromise of user data. One of the biggest effects of XSS is that it can lead to exposing user’s credentials and data. So this paper discusses an approach to mitigate the attack by using a dual-layered defence mechanism. In the first defence layer, a KNN model is used to prevent any attacker from injecting XSS scripts into the application, if the model fails to prevent this attack in the first layer, then a second layer of defence is used which uses a session mapping method where the user’s session is mapped with the user’s system details, these details include IP, OS and browser, so if the attacker tries to log in to the application with the victim’s session and if the system details don't match, then the attacker will be restricted from accessing the application. With this dual-layered defence mechanism in the application, it is very hard for an attacker to access a victim’s account.

articleTitle: Evaluation of a Novel Filter Function With Different Exponential Powers for Alleviation of Gibbs Artifacts
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: The Gibbs phenomenon in series expansion representation of an irregular function has been considered as a loop hole in numerical applications. Irregularities may occur in different ways, one of which is, intrinsically contained as discontinuities in the source data, which deteriorates the approximation of function and manifests the Gibbs artifacts. Additionally, it can be occurred due to the dynamic nature or nonlinearity of model problems in terms of shocks or fronts. In this study, a novel filter function is designed, aiming at the alleviating the oscillatory phenomenon. A new approach, comprised of spectral methods and the filter function is implemented over the discontinuous function. The efficiency of proposed filter function is illustrated through illustrations with single and multiple discontinuities. Moreover, the implementation of filter function with different powers is also analyzed that revealing variations of the reconstruction and error estimate.

articleTitle: Improving Image Classification with Quantum Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: Image classification is a fundamental task in computer vision that involves assigning labels to images based on their content. In recent years, deep learning techniques based on classical neural networks (CNN) have achieved modern performance on many image classification tasks. However, there is growing interest in using quantum neural networks (QNNs) for image classification, as quantum computing has the potential to improve the accuracy and speed of computation. We demonstrate the potential of our QNN model and QCNN model by applying it to the fashion MNIST dataset. The results indicate that the QNN model exhibits faster training speed and higher testing set accuracy compared to a QCNN with a similar architecture.

articleTitle: Seven Level Single Source Switched-Capacitor Multilevel Inverter implemented with NLC and Level Shift PWM Technique
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: This research work presents a single source Switched Capacitor Multilevel Inverter (SCMLI) topology having a capability to generate 7 discrete voltage levels with a voltage gain of 3. To unveil the superiority of the presented topology in terms of component count, diodes, and capacitors, comprehensive comparison is done with other existing SCMLI topologies. The proposed topology has 10 switches and 2 floating capacitors which are charged to Vdc and 2Vdc respectively. The presented topology has been verified in a real-time environment using Opal-RT 4510, and results for different parameters are presented in this paper. The topology has been validated using real-time simulations and the MATLAB simulation results are found to be similar to real-time simulation results.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation Of Various Machine Learning Algorithms For Class Imbalanced Landslides Identification
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: Identification of landslides is essential for risk analysis and control. However, because landslides and land displacement are extremely rare occurrences, landslide identification faces a class imbalance issue. In this research, we try to use feature engineering to enhance model performance and apply strategies to fix the imbalance problem in the landslide identification dataset. More specifically, we applied synthetic and random oversampling strategies to the landslide dataset in order to solve the class-imbalance problem. We have applied various machine learning techniques to landslide identification dataset for identifying landslide and have evaluated these algorithms. Results showed that the random forest approach outperformed alternative classification methods. The random Oversampling Technique outperformed among class-imbalance approaches as well. Feature engineering has also helped in improving performance of most models.

articleTitle: Analysis of Deep Learning Classification Models for Predicting Plant Species from Single Leaf Images
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: A large percentage of the world is owned by plants. 82.4% of the biomass of the planet is made up of plants. There are many varieties of plant species: some are edible, some are medicinal, and some are poisonous. Many people could not differentiate between one species from another. This work is aiming to classify a plant on the basis of its structure of leaf from a well-known botanical dataset named Flavia dataset. Our proposed system uses convolutional neural networks (CNN) to classify 1907 leaf images from 32 different species of plants. We evaluate the effectiveness of five CNN models using various performance measures. The experimental results indicate that the method for classification gives an average accuracy of 100% during the training phase and about 99.3% accuracy during testing phase.

articleTitle: A Novel Control algorithm for LVRT Enhancement of a Grid-Connected DFIG-Based WECS
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: This research presents a novel utilization of the fractional-order least mean p-norm (FOLMP) adaptive filtering algorithm (AFA) to enhance the capability of a grid-connected doubly fed induction generator (DFIG)-based wind energy conversion system (WECS) to withstand low voltage ride-through (LVRT) situations. The proposed method includes dynamic modifications of the scaling parameters of the adaptive fuzzy logic controllers (AFLCs) to achieve fast convergence. Within a cascaded structure, the rotor side converter (RSC) and grid side converter (GSC) utilize an adaptive fuzzy logic control topology. The RSC focuses on minimizing active power loss, while the GSC ensures a constant dc-link voltage. To assess its effectiveness during severe grid disturbances, the proposed adaptive FOLMP-FLC is compared to the least mean p-norm (LMP) based FLC and the variable step size normalized least mean p-norm (VSS-NLMP) based FLC. MATLAB simulation results demonstrate that the proposed FOLMP-FLC surpasses the LMP and VSS-NLMP approaches in terms of convergence speed, normalized misalignment error (NME), and computational load, thereby enhancing the performance of the DFIG.

articleTitle: Data Envelopment Analysis Approach for Performance Evaluation of Power Distribution Sector of Srilanka
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: Benchmarking performance is crucial for any firm. The outcomes of these benchmarking studies enable the organization or unit to evaluate their performance against that of the best organization or unit and to create strategic goals for performance enhancements. In order to verify the constant return to scale (CRS), variable return to scale (VRS), scale efficiency scores, and slack analysis to identify efficient input targets and output targets, this study investigates how to do Data Envelopment Analysis (DEA) analysis. The chosen base model for the investigation was then supported by DEA analysis using several models. The algorithm that top managers in any firm can use to evaluate and enhance relative performance is described. Using DEA, the Ceylon Electricity Board tests the relative performance of 20 regions within Distribution Division 02 (DD2) of the division. For each area, relative efficiency scores and ways to increase efficiencies are determined.

articleTitle: Multi-band Convolutional Neural Network for Efficient Utilization of Model Parameters
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: A convolutional layer of a traditional convolutional neural network (CNN) does not ensure the extraction of complementary bands of the input data. Thus a significant amount of redundancy is observed among different convolutional filters. Here, we propose a novel architecture design framework called ‘Multi-band CNN’ to efficiently utilize model parameters in a CNN. The framework generates four filters from a single filter by varying their frequency responses, extracting four complementary bands of the input data without increasing the parameter count. This leads to higher parameter utilization and results in a compact network with reduction in trainable parameter count but with close to the same accuracy as the base model. We perform experiments using residual networks (ResNet-32, ResNet-56, and ResNet-110) on datasets like CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100. Our results show improved classification accuracy for CIFAR-10 when introducing a multi-band layer in the first convolutional layer, while there is no significant drop in accuracy for CIFAR-100. The performance is better when replacing the first convolutional layer instead of the last one, indicating that low-level features generated by sub-band filtering are more beneficial to the network than high-level features provided by filter banks at the final layer. The proposed Multi-band CNN framework offers a potential solution for reducing the number of filters required to train and the computational complexity of generating feature maps in CNNs, while maintaining or even improving classification accuracy.

articleTitle: AB-LSTM: Attention Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory for Multivariate Time-Series Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: Due to its applications in numerous fields, such as weather forecasting, multivariate time series forecasting has attracted significant interest. This paper promotes AB-LSTM (Attention Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory) as an innovative method for precise multivariate time series forecasting. The AB-LSTM model combines the strengths of bidirectional LSTM (Bi-LSTM) and attention mechanisms to capture the temporal dependencies and interdependencies among multiple time series variables. The bidirectional nature of the LSTM allows the model to incorporate past and future information, enabling more robust predictions. The attention mechanism focuses on the most relevant time steps and variables, enhancing the model's ability to extract meaningful patterns and relationships from the input data. The performance of AB-LSTM is then evaluated in the experiment to the public datasets of Beijing PM2.5. The results were compared with state-of-the-art baseline models. The results demonstrate that AB-LSTM outperforms the baseline models regarding forecasting accuracy based on RMSE 20.966, particularly for long-range predictions and complex datasets. The AB-LSTM model offers interpretability by providing attention weights, indicating the relative importance of each input variable at different time steps.

articleTitle: Credit Risk Prediction using Genetic Algorithm and Stacking Ensemble
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: It is not an easy task to estimate the likelihood that a borrower will fulfill his or her duty to the lender (bank). There are several factors to take into account before deciding whether to extend any kind of loan. This decision-making process calls for sufficient quantitative data to compute, which takes time and is susceptible to error by humans. To finish this difficult and busy work, An Machine learning model for Credit Risk Prediction using Stacking Ensemble (ESCRPGSE) has been proposed as a solution to this time-consuming and difficult task. It combines oversampling technique, ‘Gaussian Smote’ to solve the imbalance problem, Genetic Algorithm to select useful features that are useful for model training, and a Stacking ensemble bagging technique for classification. By implementing 10-fold cross-validation, the proposed model’s performance is evaluated in terms of accuracy and f1-score, and it is then contrasted with standard single-classifier classifier models, ensemble-based models, and various models that have been published in the literature.

articleTitle: Mathematical Modelling and Analysis of Adaptive Traction Control for Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: This paper represents an efficient traction control method for electric vehicles, which is achieved by mapping the estimated mechanical torque demand of the wheels with respect to the electrical torque provided by the drive train motor. This is done in two ways. Firstly, a mathematical model has been developed to analyze the required traction force of the vehicle depending on various road parameters. Secondly, simulations have been performed to obtain the optimum value of traction that the vehicle requires to maintain proper stability and traction on the ground.

articleTitle: A Data Augmentation-based Road Surface Classification System using Mobile Sensing
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: Poorly constructed roads, including uneven speed bumps and rumble strips are among the primary sources of road fatalities, mainly in developing countries such as India. Real-time sensing and notification of such road surface conditions to various stakeholders may lead to timely repairs, thus minimizing road mishaps and casualties. Furthermore, with the developments in sensor technology, information retrieval and fusion algorithms, modeling these road conditions can now be done quickly, and any unevenness or damage can be identified and reported to authorities for necessary action. In this work, experiments for road surface modeling have been conducted on three types of road surface conditions, namely, rumble strips, smooth roads, and speed bumps. In order to balance our training data set, a Synthetic Minority Over-sampling Technique (SMOTE) based data augmentation technique has been used. Additionally, the k-Nearest Neighbours (k-NN) machine learning algorithm has been used to classify the various road surfaces. As a result, the model applied in this study successfully identified these road conditions with high accuracy.

articleTitle: Spectral Efficiency Evaluation of Selection Combiner under Nakagami-m fading channels using different Adaptive Transmission Techniques-A Review
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: This paper focuses on the improvement of channel capacity for mitigation of fading. Generalized closed form expressions have been evaluated for spectral efficiency for Selection Combiner (SC) under Nakagami-m fading model. In particular, adaptive transmission techniques like Optimum rate adaptation with constant power (ORA) and Channel inversion with fixed rate (CIFR) have been considered. Evaluated expressions are then plotted for different values of fading parameter under both no diversity and dual diversity. This paper provides the comparative analysis for exact and approximate spectral efficiencies under Rayleigh and worst case fading condition.

articleTitle: Derived Hybrid Multilevel Topologies for VSC-HVDC Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: The conception of modular multilevel converters (MMC) had tremendous potential for ac-dc conversion. The converters in HVDC are catalouged into line commutated converter (LCC) and voltage source converter (VSC). The MMC belongs to the family of VSC and became the most favored VSC topology for HVDC. In the midst of its popularity, the MMC with half bridge submodule lacked dc fault blocking capability thus behaving as uncontrolled rectifier during dc fault. The MMC constraints are resolved by derived topologies to meet the industrial demands. The article investigates the outline of MMC into its derived topologies. Various schematic circuits are presented in this paper and their comparative analysis is carried out to identify the advantages and limitations.

articleTitle: Robust Battery Management System for Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: Battery Management System (BMS) is an intrinsic module in electric vehicles (EVs), which ensures safe, efficient and economical operation by monitoring the real time battery status and safeguards the system from overcharging and undercharging. The state of charge (SOC) and state of health (SOH) are the two key decision making, battery health monitoring parameters in a BMS. This paper addresses the problem of estimation of state of charge (SOC) and state of health (SOH) of batteries for BMS used in EVs. The SOC and SOH are estimated using Unscented Kalman filter (UKF) algorithm. A novel adaptive algorithm, derived based on Lyapunov theory, has been proposed to tune the threshold on SOC for diverse operating conditions. The algorithm has been designed in such a way that the knowledge of SOH is not required for tuning the threshold on SOC adaptively.

articleTitle: Investigation on Photovoltaic Cells with Battery Integration
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: To combat intermittency, this study depends on the effective use of battery storage systems in standalone solar PV applications. Low voltage applications are suited for the majority of renewable energy sources. As a result, it’s essential in a DC Microgrid to enhance low level voltage obtained to meet the DC bus voltage requirement. At each step, the duty of the voltage regulator of the boost converter connected to the solar installation is regulated in order to extract the most amount of energy from it. A dual-active bridge (DAB) based isolated DC-DC converter has been utilised for high power transfer, two-way power flow, quick dynamic control, and with smaller size. In this work, solar PV is connected to the dc bus via two unidirectional dc-dc boost converters, the output voltage of the boost converter is highly fluctuating and to regulate the voltage to be constant another boost converter has been used to connect with the common dc bus and the battery is interfaced to the common dc bus through an isolated bidirectional dual active bridge dc-dc converter. Through the transformer’s leakage inductance, the direction of power flow from the high voltage side to the battery side and vice-versa, is automatically controlled based on dual-phase shift control. In the MATLAB/SIMULINK 2020a environment, the working of the standalone solar PV system with the suggested battery converter control has been proven in both charging and discharging mode, and a selector algorithm has been devised to maintain constant voltage at the dc bus.

articleTitle: Dual Band Meander Line Antenna for 5G and WLAN Application
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: In order to support 5G wireless WLAN applications, this study offers a Meander Line Antenna (MLA) design for dual-frequency operating at 2.4GHz and 5GHz.The proposed antenna is designed on an FR4 substrate withdimensions of 30 x 30 x 1.6mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>. The MLA design overcomes the limited range of 2.4 GHz connections by utilizing the faster speeds offered by the 5 GHz frequency. Different methodologies like introducing parasitic element, defected ground structure (DGS) is used to achieve the required. The proposed antenna's performance is examinedin terms of gain, radiation pattern, and return loss. The measured return loss at 2.4 GHz and 5 GHz is found to be -34.88 and -12.56, respectively, meeting the requirements of 5G applications with maximum gain of 3.47 dB.

articleTitle: Prediction of Session Duration of Electric Vehicle Using Machine Learning and Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: In order to avoid the emission occurring due to the traditional ICE based Vehicles the majority of the population is shifting towards EVs as they have the capability to decrease the emission by 45 percent, but with EVs, there is an issue of range anxiety due to the limited power supply in existing charging infrastructure which prevents the charging of many EV simultaneously, In order to resolve this smart charging algorithm which utilizes Machine Learning (ML) to learn the EV charging behavior pattern, In order to maximize the equal share among EVs by prioritizing for an equal chance to reach a sufficient state of charge by the end of charging along with this precise charging time can mitigate the problem caused to drivers due to unavoidable charging behavior, in order to address these issue there is a need for accurate prediction of session duration or departure time. In, this research we have utilized the ACN dataset for historical charging data. Along with this, we have also utilized real-time climatic conditions in order to get more accurate and realistic results of the prediction by using various ML and Neural Networks out of which we got the best results through Random forest(RF) and Ensemble model with MAE of 30.75 minutes and 19.97 minutes, the prediction result revealed that addition of climatic data helps in improving the prediction accuracy and provide better results.

articleTitle: Securing IoT with Blockchain: Detecting Malicious Nodes with TLS Certificates
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: Since the emergence of the Internet of Things (IoTs), the potential for connecting devices with other devices, to collect and exchange data has been widely becoming an integrated part of human society. The ongoing development and innovation have also reached various other domains. However, there are still some significant security measures and trust issues that need to be resolved to make the Internet of Things more secure and reliable. Blockchain technology emerged as one potential solution for the security-related goals of IoTs. There has been a growing interest in exploring the potential for integrating blockchain technology with the Internet of Things(IoTs). Blockchain provides distributed immutable ledger that keeps track of transactions done by nodes connected to its network. However, security risks remain, such as the potential inclusion of malicious nodes in the blockchain network. To address this, we propose a method that uses TLS certificates to identify and prevent malicious nodes from joining the blockchain network, ensuring the reliability and security of the distributed ledger.

articleTitle: A Simulation Study of ZnO/Si Based Efficient UV-Photodetector in COMSOL Multiphysics
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: This paper reports a simulation study of ZnO/Si-based photodetection structure in COMSOL Multiphysics. The optical performance of the resultant device has been explored under a broad light illumination with a uniform optical power of 10 µW.
