The photon conversion parameter of the resultant device, known as responsivity, has been measured for a broad (UV-visible) spectrum. The obtained results show the potentiality of the ZnO/Si structure for UV illumination detection. The proposed device shows the responsivity of 4.5 A/W for 380 nm illumination at -2 V. The efficient light detection along with the low detection volume of the device has proven its potential impact on optoelectronics applications including UV detection

articleTitle: Prediction of COVID-19 using Hybrid Voting Classifier
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: Due to continuous spread of deadly corona virus, the World Health Organization (WHO) announced pandemic on March 11, 2020, and termed it as COVID-19. The virus named SARS-coronavirus 2 is the main cause of COVID-19 (SARSCOV-2). Based on observation, it has been found that COVID-19 has impact on cardiovascular and cardiorespiratory systems. Therefore, this paper proposes a new hybrid voting classifier based COVID-19 predicting model based on cardiovascular and cardiorespiratory systems. The COVID-19 data is provided by Physionet for this study. First, pre-processing is done on the data followed by feature extraction, reduction, and classification. Then, the Hybrid Voting Classifier is applied in order to predict the presence of COVID-19. This classifier is a mixture of the Support Vector Machine (SVM), K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN), Naive Bayes (NB), Random Forest, and Decision Tree Classifiers machine learning techniques. A precision evaluation of the suggested model is performed. The proposed hybrid voting classifier model delivers the highest accuracy (85%) of any machine learning classifiers we tested in terms of prediction of COVID-19.

articleTitle: A Light Convolutional Neural Network Architecture for Cross-Spectral Face Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: The rise in the utilization of multispectral imaging in surveillance, biometrics, and forensics has led to Cross-Spectral Face Recognition becoming a pertinent problem to solve. For instance, surveillance cameras switch from utilizing the Visible (VIS) spectrum during the day to the Near Infrared (NIR) spectrum at night, in order to capture footage in the dark. The process of matching face images captured on different sensing modalities is called Cross-Spectral Face Recognition (CSFR) also known as Heterogeneous Face Recognition (HFR). The variation in spectral characteristics between the NIR and VIS face images makes face recognition across these two information domains a challenging problem to solve. This adds to the complexity of building an efficient and accurate model that performs cross-spectral face recognition across the NIR and VIS domains. This paper proposes a light CNN model that performs cross-spectral face recognition across the NIR and VIS spectra. The proposed model has obtained higher accuracy scores when compared to denser Convolutional Neural Networks on CSFR across both spectra on various benchmark datasets such as CASIA NIR-VIS 2.0 (97.12%), Oulu-CASIA (99.85%), and HIT Lab2 (96.88%). Furthermore, this model attained the aforementioned accuracy scores with significantly fewer trainable parameters (0.102 million parameters).

articleTitle: Design of Dual Band Dipole Loaded With Dielectric Resonator Antenna
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: A novel design of half-wave dipole antenna loaded with a dielectric resonator acting as a dual-band antenna is presented in this work. In S-Band, the impedance bandwidth is 0.63 GHz (22.38 %) and in C-Band, the impedance bandwidth is 2.56 GHz (45 %), the cross-polarization level is 50 dB below co-polarization level and a directive gain of 4.845 dBi at 2.7 GHz and 7.925 dBi of gain at 5.55 GHz.

articleTitle: FPGA Implementation and Validation of Particle Swarm Optimization suited for varied applications
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) is a metaheuristic algorithm that iteratively optimizes a problem to get the optimal solution. In the field of electrical and electronic engineering, it has numerous applications. This optimization technique is largely used in software. However, hardware implementation of PSO results in high performance. In this paper, the three-variable sphere function is the problem that is being optimized. PSO is implemented on FPGA by developing Verilog HDL code. Digilent Basys3 Xilinx board is used to implement PSO in hardware and display the results. The binary output is shown on the basys3 board using LEDs, and it is then converted to decimal numbers using a binary-to-decimal number converter. The entire Verilog HDL code contains 3 modules and six 16 bit binary outputs. The basys3 board’s LEDs are used to display these 16 bit binary outputs. Then two 16 bit numbers are merged to form a 32 bit number and it is converted into a decimal number using a binary-to-decimal converter. The values obtained from the MATLAB implementation of PSO are used to verify the final outputs of the hardware implementation. Also, the results obtained from the hardware implementation are converging and are accurate with the results obtained from MATLAB. Finally, an application is implemented where PSO is used to estimate the equivalent circuit parameters for the induction motor.

articleTitle: Nanomagnetic Logic Simulation of Digital Design
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: Nanomagnetic Logic (NML) is one of the most promising technologies at present. It consists of very small-sized magnets, which represent a magnetic domain. These circuits work with extremely low switching power dissipations and consume less power. Currently, the case studies are based on smaller and simple circuits without any specific focus on the effects of geometry on signal propagation and decoupling. In this paper, we present a brief overview of NML, some basic circuits, and the simulations of various focal circuits and show the effects of the geometry of magnets on the signal in NML logic circuits.

articleTitle: Accelerating fluid flow in Quantum Computing using GPU
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: In the last few years, quantum computing has evolved as the next big technological breakthrough. Many big companies are actively researching this area and have built open-source frameworks which can be used to develop solutions for problems that connect be solved by classical computers. One such problem is the solution of Navier-Stokes equations which takes exponential time for simulation but using quantum computers, they can be solved in polynomial time. But the current state of quantum computation does not enable everyone to test their implementation on a real quantum computer. In this situation, a simulator enables rapid prototype and testing techniques and algorithms for when the real quantum computer is ready. This paper focuses on simulating fluid flow algorithms using a quantum framework, such as Navier- Stokes equations, with the lattice Boltzmann method (LBM) used to numerically solve the relevant system of equations on both CPU and GPU to speed up the process. The quantum framework used in this paper is Qiskit, an open-source software development kit created by IBM that allows developers to create and test quantum algorithms. NVIDIA cuQuantum is an SDK of optimized libraries and tools for expediting quantum computing operations used in this paper to solve the fundamental problem of modeling large-size quantum circuits using the power of GPU

articleTitle: A Survey on Visible Light Communication for 6G: Architecture, Application and Challenges
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: One of the factors contributing to provide data transmission in 6G based on visible-light communications (VLC) is the rising demand for high-speed indoor wireless connectivity. This article classifies the technical influences that the transition from 5G to 6G requires. The purpose of this paper is to speculate on the possible applications of visible light communications (VLC) for a 6G technology platform. Aspects of increasing data rates and reducing interference are among the research topics that need more investigation. The establishment of suitable spectrally efficient multiple-access (MA) techniques facilitates the effective management of multiple users, specifically when working with the restricted modulation bandwidth of the light-emitting diodes, in relatively large space indoor environments. The paper concentrates on the suggested specifications of applications, the network architecture and its significant performance indicators for VLC aided applications in 6G. Finally, some potential directions for future study in VLC for 6G are examined.

articleTitle: A LIME-Based Explainable Machine Learning Technique for the Risk Prediction of Chronic Kidney Disease
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: Chronic Kidney Disease (CKD) is on the rise in the current research scenario. The main function of the kidney is to remove and purify the waste and blood in the human body. Diabetes is the most prevalent cause of kidney disease. The key to preventing or curing CKD is identifying it at an early stage. If early detection is avoided, there is a greater chance of kidney failure as well as heart disease, bone disease, or an imbalance in potassium and calcium levels. Prediction at an early stage for a long and healthy life is made feasible with the assistance of a machine intelligence classifier. In this study, the prediction of CKD and Non-CKD patients is done by applying five machine learning classifiers. The results show that the Random Forest classifier has the greatest accuracy of all classifiers. Explainable artificial intelligence (XAI) is introduced for a trustworthy explanation of the result. XAI investigates how the Random Forest model gives high accuracy with input features imported into the classifier.

articleTitle: Fall detection system for monitoring elderly people using YOLOv7-pose detection model
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: The elderly population in the world is continuing to grow at an unparalleled rate and it is important to keep in mind about the safety of the aging population. Falls have become one of the major reasons leading to injury to them and if timely help is not provided, it could lead to serious complications. There are various traditional methods that have been used to detect human falls and wearable devices are one of these methods that contain sensors like accelerometer, gyroscope, barometers, etc. These devices are highly instrumental in computing various parameters based on which the fall will be detected. However, these devices have certain limitations, as they are complex for the elderly people to understand and use. The accuracy of such devices is very low and there are high chances for false alarms as well. Hence, applying a vision-based object detection algorithm for detecting these human falls is highly significant in order to overcome such challenges faced by wearable devices. In this research work, an Object detection based Automated Fall Detection System has been proposed wherein, the YOLOv7 (You Only Look Once) pose model is used to discriminate the fall and non-fall activity. Given a video, the YOLOv7 model will first distinctly separate all the video frames and then pre-process these frames. This pre-processed data is sent for estimating the pose of the person. This resulting output is further subjected to classification as fall or non-fall activity. The dataset used in our approach are self-generated videos that cover a set of daily human activities. The strength of the proposed method has been proved through various performance measures like precision and classification accuracy.

articleTitle: An Efficient Approach For To Predict The Quality Of Apple Through Its Appearance
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: Freshness attracts buyers and money for sellers. How effective will it be to automatically classify vegetables and fruits according to the freshness rate? Well, the next question comes from each one of us, is it possible or not? Yes, it is possible. This study focuses on the classification of apples based on parameters for setting their freshness. For the sake of classification, we have trained the model using CNN i.e., convolutional neural networks. Using this model apples are classified based on their appearance which is one of the most common approaches taken by humans while manually classifying apples. It is an easy, time-effective, and precise method that we prefer as the basic or most popular parameter to define the freshness of any fruit and vegetable is through their image. Using this approach, we have used CNN architectures VGG16 and Inception V3 and their accuracies were 86% and 93%. The model which is being created by us is tested on four activation functions such as read, sigmoid, tanh, and linear.

articleTitle: NS4: a Novel Security approach for extracted video keyframes using Secret Sharing Scheme
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: Due to the vast employment and high impacts of videos in the multimedia era, video security has become a key research area in multimedia security. Hence, it is necessary to prevent sensitive data from being misappropriated, used, or destroyed in diverse fields like the military, finance, and education. Secure communication is not easy as various mediums produce much multimedia (video) data. Users must spend a lot of time and effort scanning an enormous amount of video information in search of essential information. Therefore, a secure keyframes-based generic video summarization (VS) model is proposed to generate a secure video summary. First, secret keyframes are extracted from the video through the proposed Saliency-Based Video Summarization (SBVS) technique. Second, secret image sharing is provided to the secret keyframes by the proposed EBSS (Encoding Based Secret Sharing) scheme, which uses encoding and XOR concepts for keyframes security. The proposed model outperforms generated summary and security compared to the existing keyframe-based VS and Secret Sharing Scheme (SSS) techniques.

articleTitle: Dung Beetle Optimizer Algorithm Based OPF Solution considering Renewable Energy Sources
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: This paper introduces the Dung Beetle Optimizer (DBO), a novel meta-heuristic algorithm designed for solving the optimal power flow (OPF) problem while considering the integration of solar and wind energy sources. As these sources exhibit stochastic behavior, it is crucial for the system operator (SO) to account for their inherent uncertainty to achieve significantly more accurate results. Consequently, the estimation of solar and wind power generation relies on the utilization of Log-normal and Weibull probability density functions, respectively. To showcase the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm in addressing the OPF problem, it is implemented on both standard and modified IEEE 30-bus system within the MATLAB programming environment. The outcomes of the DBO algorithm are extensively evaluated and compared against various other optimization methods. These comprehensive comparative analyses conclusively demonstrate the reliability and effectiveness of the proposed approach in effectively tackling intricate power system challenges. In the realm of hybrid power systems, the proposed DBO algorithm holds potential as a valuable decision-making tool for system operators, offering significant assistance in navigating complex decision-making scenarios.

articleTitle: Dual-encrypted privacy preservation in Blockchain-enabled IoT healthcare system
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: For the benefit of many healthcare stakeholders, wearable technology and the Internet of Things (IoT) are now experiencing exponential growth in the healthcare sector. Yet, due to the IoT’s centralized aspect, the existing healthcare system encounters privacy and security difficulties while storing and exchanging individual healthcare data over the Internet. Fortunately, the underlying Blockchain technology offers decentralization qualities with great security and high trust. In this paper, We propose a framework with the integration of Blockchain & IoT in the Healthcare system. A novel Dual-encryption approach, which combines symmetric and asymmetric cryptographic techniques, is used here to maintain data privacy. Additionally, we use a digital signature technique to improve security and privacy as the system contains vital patient information. Moreover, a Comparative analysis has been done with existing models to ensure the better performance of the proposed model.

articleTitle: Metahuristics based task scheduling algorithm in cloud
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: Cloud computing is the most trending technologies over the internet that offers numerous computing services to the users like servers, databases, software and storage that are highly scalable and cost-effective. The services provided by the cloud work on the pay-as-you-go principle which means that you can either scale up or down the resources provided by the cloud as per your requirements. Cloud computing is a highly effective and reliable technique, however, scheduling numerous tasks over cloud can result in underutilization or overutilization of resources. Thus, to map the tasks on the resources efficiently, the need to use meta-heuristic algorithms arises. The use of these algorithms provides a near-optimal or optimal solution. MEALPY is a python library which offers optimized solutions for nature-based meta-heuristics algorithms. Biological systems, Swarm intelligence, Evolutionary-based and human based meta-heuristic algorithms are used to solve real world scheduling optimization problems. In this study, we have proposed a detailed and substantiated comparison of different nature-based meta-heuristic algorithms on the basis of various variables which affects the effectiveness of execution time in scheduling tasks over cloud for achieving better optimal solution for task scheduling.

articleTitle: Gastro-Intestinal Tract Image Segmentation using Edge U-Net and U-Net VGG19
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: In this work, an approach to tackle the problem of image segmentation on MRI scans of cancer patients using deep learning techniques has been proposed. Radio oncologists are challenged with a tedious task of segmenting the stomach and intestine regions manually. Based on the segmented regions, oncologists need to deliver high doses of X-Ray beams to treat the tumor cells while avoiding the healthy intestine and stomach regions. Using deep learning based segmentation techniques this process can be automated, which would lead to better treatment and save a lot of time. This work proposes a methodology using Edge U-Net and U-Net VGG19 to efficiently segment the large bowel, small bowel and stomach regions from the MRI scans of cancer patients. Experiments were conducted on the proposed methodology and results were compared with U-Net, Feature Pyramid Network and U-Net++ with variant encoders such as ResNet50, Xception, EfficientNet-B0, ResNeXT50. Comparison results show that the proposed methodology Edge U-Net and U-Net VGG19 has achieved the highest weighted Dice coefficient and 3D Hausdorff distance value of 0.86194.

articleTitle: BlockAgro: Towards Blockchain assisted IoST Framework for Agricultural Sector
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: Blockchain and Internet of Spatial Things (IoST) integration in smart agricultural systems employing Geographical Information System (GIS) provides agricultural systems with decentralized, trustworthy, secure, dependable, scalable, traceable, and transparent services. Most previous research uses IoT to automate agricultural systems without addressing security, scalability, single-point failure, access control, trust, and transparency concerns. With an expanded marketplace, distributors, producers, buyers, sellers, and other agricultural users, the previously proposed cloud-based and centralized agricultural systems faced limits in data collection, sharing, management, processing, storing, availability, security, auditability, and stability. To address the challenges that exist in IoST agricultural systems, we propose BlockAgro, a Blockchain-assisted IoST framework for the agricultural sector, with a three-tier architecture, namely an IoST device layer, a fog layer, and a cloud layer, to address the issues in IoT agricultural systems. Additionally, it provides data analysis, visualization, processing, filtration, and temporary storage of gathered IoST data at the nearest fog nodes to reduce cloud infrastructure overhead. Moreover, the experimental findings of the proposed framework ensure the access control mechanism for IoST devices, efficiency measurement metrics, and data availability in a decentralized agricultural platform.

articleTitle: sEMG-Based Classification of Finger Movement with Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: Classification of finger movements is a challenging task due to the complications introduced by noise artifacts on low amplitude biopotential signals. Electromyography enables the visualization and analysis of changes in biopotential signal due to different muscular activities, which further allows the classification of muscular signals. In this article, surface electromyography (sEMG) based signal has been collected from two forearm muscles corresponding to the dominant hand, using the BIOPAC acquisition system. The raw signal collected, has been pre-processed using static filtering techniques and converted into seventeen time domain and frequency domain based features. Conversion of filtered signal into features is done using overlapping windowing technique. The thirty four extracted features corresponding to two muscles are used as input in five machine learning (ML) classifiers and a comparative analysis has been presented among those classifiers using performance measures such as Accuracy, Precision, Recall, and F1-score.

articleTitle: AGROFERDURE: Intelligent Crop Recommendation System For Agriculture Crop Productivity Using Machine Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: Farming is the backbone of India. The yield of a modern-day farmer in India depends on many factors ranging from their economic conditions to environmental factors, and their habitat. A shortage in any of these factors would result in large scale loss of yield of farmer’s crop. To reduce losses incurred by the farmers we are trying to lend a helping hand by developing a tool for them. With the help of Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence Technology this project provides yield improvement in various geographical areas with specific crops. Our Project collects information from the farmer and uses it to provide accurate and optimal recommendations to them which include information about soil and its nature in which the farmer wishes to cultivate. Depending upon this information our project provides the farmer with the best possible fertilizer and crop recommendation which enhances the yield. This information collected is stored in order to facilitate future use. The Technology and Algorithms used for this are Machine Learning, Regression and Recommendation Algorithms.

articleTitle: Voltage-lift Type Impedance-Network Improved-Z-Source Inverter
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: In this artefact, an innovative topology of voltage-lift type Improved Z-source inverters (VL-IZSI) is presented. The capacitor, C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">VL</inf> replaces the center diode of the top switched inductor (SL) cell and the bottommost a single inductor is swapped and with SL cell, L2 in Improved-ZSI to obtain the improved voltage gain. Consequently, the quantity of submissive apparatuses and diodes are condensed, which reduces the price, heaviness, and astronomical obligation of the structure once associated with SL-ZSI, extended boost-qZSI, and enhanced-boost (q)ZSIs. Moreover, the suggested inverter configuration uses little duty cycle to obtain the high voltage gain at improved modulation index that enhances the output assessment quality with less THD for a specified supply voltage. The proposed structure is examined under steady-state conditions, and its theoretical interpretation is tested using MATLAB/Simulink.

articleTitle: A Superior Boost Active-Switched Impedance Network Quasi Z-Source Inverter
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: In these modern days, the inspiration is all about the safeguarding of conservative sources besides increasing the usage of the renewable energy source conversion. The old-style inverters like the voltage source inverter (VSI) and current source inverter (CSI) have a limitation of the buck or boost in the output. These limitations are overcome through the impedance (Z) source inverter (ZSI) in the earlier times. Various topological developments were introduced since then like qZSI, SL-ZSI/qZSI, ASC-ZSI/qZSI etc. This Z-source network is applied in each and every energy conversion system (like AC-DC, DC-DC, DC-AC, AC-AC). The evolution of these topologies is due to the boost factor improvement and voltage gain enhancement which indulges to reduction in multiple stage conversion and economical correlation of the converter circuits. One such topology is introduced in this project. This brief proposes two superior boost active switched impedance quasi-Z source inverter topologies, in which the acquired boost factor is nearly equal to 2/(2(1 − D)<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> −1). The D represents the duty ratio of the inverter switches and range of the duty ratio is in the limit of 0 < D < 0.206. The boost factor of the proposed topologies is also increased when compared with the conventional topologies proposed ever since. For the same number of components, the voltage stresses across the capacitors, inverter bridge is reduced in the first topology rather than the second topology. The theoretical and Simulink verification are also illustrated in the brief.

articleTitle: Commercial Indian Bamboo Species Classification on matK DNA Barcode Sequences using Machine Learning Techniques with K-mer
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: Bamboo, a grass, belongs to the Poaceae family, with 1642 species from 116 genera worldwide. It has exceptional physical, chemical, and mechanical qualities, which allow it to be employed in over a thousand different ways and contribute to a trade value of USD 2.76 billion. Bamboo is grown using rhizomes, tissue culture, or short branch cuttings without any other checks resulting in incorrect species identification and categorisation. Therefore, the classification or identification of these bamboo use its DNA barcode sequences with a K-mer based method, and machine learning (ML) is the most excellent strategy for resolving issues with the conventional or traditional categorisation of the species. A DNA barcode is a brief genetic signature that helps identify the species to which an organism belongs. It is possible to extract a useful feature from genome sequences using K-mer based approaches, which may then be used to increase comparison accuracy. In this research, we evaluate the classification performance of four supervised ML models on the DNA-barcode sequence of six Indian commercial bamboo species with a different K-mer combination. For this classification, we choose matK barcode region and supervised ML models such as Logistic Regression (LR), Random Forest (RF), Support Vector Machine (SVM) and Gradient Boosting Machine (GBM). The results analysis of these models on the matK DNA sequence with different K-mers demonstrates that the classification capabilities of the GBM approaches are quite promising, and it has an accuracy of 95.3% on average.

articleTitle: From Templates to Transformers: A survey of Multimodal Image Captioning Decoders
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: Automated text-to-image (image synthesis) and image-to-text (image captioning) generation are two of the most challenging and cutting-edge fields of study in Computer Vision (CV) in conjunction with Natural Language Processing (NLP). The image-to-text synthesis, also known as Image Captioning (IC), has numerous applications in visual assistance, machine vision, remote security, healthcare, and remote sensing, among others. Since their origin, the IC frameworks have been constructed utilizing a two-subcomponent pipeline consisting of the visual feature extraction and natural language modeling subcomponents. The recent surge of interest in the applications of sequential deep learning models in machine translation has resulted in the development of efficient language modeling architectures. Deep sequential modeling architectures, such as Recurrent Neural Networks (RNN), Long Short Term Memory (LSTM), and Gated Recurrent Units (GRU), tackle the intricacies of the multi-modular space far better than existing machine learning-based translation approaches. The tremendous growth of deep language modeling architectures in IC necessitates a comprehensive review of its literature. In this survey, we conduct an exhaustive and analytical analysis of the language modeling architectures used in IC frameworks for caption generation, along with their training corpus datasets. We also identify a list of open research issues and potential research areas for future work.

articleTitle: Comparative analysis of directional overcurrent relay coordination using linear and nonlinear protection schemes
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: In this paper, the relay coordination problem is formulated as a linear and non-linear optimization problem with a number of operational constraints. The primary objective of DOCR coordination is to identify the optimal relay settings to achieve the least overall operation time of all relays without any relay pair miscoordination. Also, a comparative analysis of relay coordination has been performed using standard and user-defined relay characteristics. In this study, the application of grey wolf optimization (GWO) for the optimal coordination of DOCRs in a mesh power system is discussed. Additionally, in terms of optimization algorithm, the obtained results are also compared with a genetic algorithm (GA). The performance of the proposed algorithm is tested on the distribution part of a modified IEEE-14 bus test system.

articleTitle: Performance of Interpolation Techniques for Compression of Crop Image: A Comparative Study
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: Image processing technology plays an important role in the field of cultivation. Its applications are rapidly increasing in agriculture fields such as disease identification, prevention, and crop health monitoring. Generally, good quality crop images are captured using high-resolution cameras, which need huge storage space and large bandwidth for transmission. Therefore, a strong motivation is there to develop an efficient algorithm for the compression and reconstruction of crop images. In this regard, the singular vector sparse reconstruction (SVSR) method is proposed by Xu et al., for image compression. This method is examined for compression and reconstruction of crop images using different types of interpolation methods such as Next-neighbor interpolation (NxNI, Previous-neighbor interpolation (PNI), Nearest-neighbor interpolation (NNI), Cubic spline interpolation (CSI), Piecewise Cubic Hermite Interpolating Polynomial (PCHIP), Makima interpolation (MI) and Linear interpolation (LI). The performance of these interpolation is assessed in terms of the following parameters such as compression ratio, peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR), structural similarity index (SSIM), and mean-square error (MSE). According to the results of the tests and comparisons, PCHIP and MI interpolation methods with SVSR technique has provided comparatively better performance for compression and reconstruction of crop images.

articleTitle: Study of Threats and Security Aspects of Unmanned Ariel Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: Unmanned Ariel Vehicles (UAVs), commonly known as drones, are pilotless aircraft or robots that can fly to almost unrestrained locations. These UAVs can operate with or without human intervention while having complete autonomy and flexibility, making them the subject of concerted research over the past few decades. Also, UAVs have a broad range of applications, which are generic and specific, ranging from civilian to military usage. The UAV System is easily deployable and user-friendly because of its modular nature, consisting of the Flying Object, Base Control Station, and Communication Link. However, it also makes the UAV System prone to security threats in the context of Hardware, Software, and Communication Link. The UAV System being infrastructureless mainly operates through wireless communication links and can be attacked in various ways, such as spoofing, false data injection, fuzzing, jamming confidentiality, and integrity attacks. Hence, the primary security concern is to secure the data that controls the Flying Object and the data that consists of the information gathered. UAVs typically send the data to the ground station over a wireless link which attackers can easily target. To overcome these security threats, researchers and scientists have been continuously investigating the vulnerabilities and weaknesses of UAV systems and have proposed various countermeasures. In this work, an attempt has been made to study different types of UAV Systems, its applications along with security threats and their countermeasures.

articleTitle: A Deep Learning Approach for Development of Web Application for Automated Knee OA Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: Knee Osteoarthritis (OA), often referred to as "Degenerative Joint disorder," is one of the most prevalent forms of musculoskeletal disease. Surgery for joint replacement persists to be the only option for treating severe knee OA. Hence, an early identification of a disease enhances the likelihood that a person will receive treatment at the initial onset. However, it has been averted due to a lack of adequate medical infrastructure in the country’s suburbs and rural areas. The automatic grading of knee OA severity using Computer Aided Diagnosis (CAD) from radiograph images has been garnering substantial attention. On account of this, we have suggested a deep learning-based automated lightweight architecture which can be used for the development of web application having the least computational burden. The tasks of feature extraction and classification have been automated by using transfer learning based VGG16-inspired 6-layer architecture (I-VGG16), thereby reducing the computational burden of the classification framework. For the suggested web-application, the user will have to upload a knee-radiograph image, and the trained CNN model at the back-end classifies an image accordingly into one of the five KL grades. Finally, the application generates a document identical to the medical report according to obtained severity grade. With an outstanding classification accuracy of 87.95%, our framework outperforms prior work in this area. As a consequence, the excellent performance results demonstrate the model’s ability to be deployed in routine usage for knee OA grade classification.

articleTitle: Connectivity Measures based Imagined Speech Recognition using parallel ReliefF-NCA based Channel Selection
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: Recently imagined speech-based BCI systems are becoming quite popular among researchers because they are not dependent on external stimuli, and their generation is easy. Even though so much work is done related to imagined speech, they are still not feasible. In order to make practical imagined speech-based systems that are cost-efficient and easy to use, systems having higher accuracies, even with a small number of electrodes, are required. In an imagined speech, one electrode to 64 electrodes EEG devices were used, and it is seen that accuracy decreases when the number of channels is reduced. As the specific region for imagined speech production is still debatable, location-specific electrode distribution is not suitable in all scenarios. Therefore, the need for a suitable channel selection method arises that can reduce the number of channels without affecting accuracy. This work proposes a parallel ReliefF-NCA-based channel selection method in which, firstly parallel combination of ReliefF and Neighborhood Component Analysis (NCA) optimized using a Bayesian algorithm is used for feature selection. Furthermore, with the help of the importance of features related to a particular channel, the selection of channels is performed.

articleTitle: Improving Power Quality in Hybrid PV - Wind Operated Standalone System with Dual Inverters by Using TSK Fuzzy Controllers
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: Supplying electrical power to consumers through renewable energy sources based hybrid standalone systems is a best choice to reduce global warming instead of using diesel generators in isolated locations worldwide. Moreover, standalone hybrid power supply systems are also becoming popular in many urban areas including hospitals, universities, institutions, small scale industries and agriculture fields due to their features. Generally a storage device is required to achieve power balance between generation and load since both are randomly varying in such kinds of power supply systems. Hence a battery bank is included in the hybrid standalone system which is designed by Photovoltaic (PV) and PMSG based wind power generation system. In order to supply quality power to consumers, effective control coordination is required among all components in the system. Moreover, single generation systems of PV and wind cannot maintain load demand in high power systems. Therefore multiple PV and wind systems are considered in this paper for connecting at common dc-link to meet the load demand. Further an inverter is connected between dc-link and AC loads. Hence, the system can have the facility of both dc and AC microgrids to operate both kinds of loads. Under this scenario, constant voltage at both dc-link and AC load bus should be supplied to maintain the power quality in the system. Hence, a novel control technique is implemented in this paper for supplying quality power to both dc and AC loads. However, conventional PI controllers are unable to produce accurate output under rapid changes in input. Therefore, Takagi Sugeno Kang (TSK) Fuzzy controllers are adopted in proposed control schemes. Two inverters are considered in this paper, one is connected between dc-link and AC loads and another is in between AC load bus and battery system. Moreover a bidirectional dc-dc converter is incorporated between battery bank and inverter to maintain power balance. In this configuration, the inverter between battery system and AC load bus can also acts as inter line power flow controller. In order to present the responses similar to real time, the Hardware-in the-Loop (HIL) is implemented with the help of OPAL-RT modules.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Techniques for Malware Detection: A Comprehensive Survey
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: Malware detection and familial classification approaches based on deep learning (DL) techniques have emerged as a promising solution in recent years. The ability of deep neural networks (DNNs) to learn complex patterns and features from malware samples has resulted in high detection rates and has attracted the attention of researchers in the field of cyber-security. The use of deep learning algorithms in malware detection and familial classification can help to improve the accuracy and efficiency of existing methods and can also be used to detect new and unknown malware variants. DL-based malware detection models are proven to outperform traditional, state-of-the-art machine learning models. Therefore, there exists a greater significance in reviewing existing DL-based malware detection techniques alone. This survey presents a comprehensive overview of state-of-the-art DL techniques used for malware detection. Although there exist few works that review machine learning and deep learning-based malware detection techniques, and to the best of our knowledge, only a limited number of surveys focused on deep learning-based malware detection techniques alone. Overall, this survey provides a comprehensive overview of the recent works in the field that are intended to be a valuable resource for researchers, practitioners, and anyone interested in deep learning-based malware detection. We also present the open issues and challenges in this area which require research attention.

articleTitle: An Investigation: Effective Use of the Internet of Things (IoT) in the Construction Industry
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: One concern that may develop is that the construction business has fallen behind other industries due to the proliferation of the Internet of Things (IoT) networks. Therefore, the construction sector should immediately begin using IoT technologies to ensure building projects’ swift and efficient completion. The best option for meeting the urgent demands of growing nations like India in terms of infrastructure and building is to use IoT technologies to increase productivity on the job. To determine whether or not IoT applications can be successfully implemented at various stages of a construction project’s life cycle, it is necessary to conduct a critical literature evaluation of several scholarly articles and theses. The primary purpose of this article is to use a well-crafted questionnaire survey to examine the viability of the IoT in the construction business, namely in the Vadodara and Anand areas of central Gujarat. After a survey, the nominal analysis will determine the order of most-used IoT apps in the business world. This article ranks the three most and least widely used IoT applications in the construction sector, focusing on the region where the study was done.

articleTitle: Cylindrical Dielectric Resonator Antenna Optimization: A Machine Learning Perspective
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: Designing a Cylindrical Dielectric Resonator Antenna (CDRA) is complicated by its many physical characteristics and ideal values. Using real-world data to calculate a precise numerical response from experimental investigations is tricky. Machine learning methods solve this issue. After proper training, the machine learning approach eliminates the need for antenna design iterations, resulting in a fast and precise solution. The S11 parameter of a cylindrical dielectric resonator antenna is determined in this study by using a frequency range of 4-12 GHz, a height range of 9-11 mm, and a radius range of 7-9 mm. Additionally, multiple machine learning algorithms are employed to find the parameter. This research presents several different types of algorithms, such as Decision Tree, KNN, Random Forest, XGBoost, and Deep Neural Networks. The HFSS software is used to generate the data set that will be utilized in the training and validation of these algorithms. In addition, the findings of the proposed methodologies are compared to the values that were simulated, and it is shown that both sets of results are in agreement. Nevertheless, the outcomes of the KNN, Random Forest, and Deep Neural Network procedures are noticeably superior to those of the other methods.

articleTitle: Data Correlation behaviour on Privacy Leakage in Differential Privacy
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: Massive static or continuous data generated from day-to-day life activities has eventually led to increased analysis and statistical data publishing. Differential privacy has also seen a significant rise in attention as a privacy framework. Many of the existing privacy methods still use the traditional Differential privacy mechanism as a tool to publish private data to protect privacy. However, these privacy methods completely ignore the fact that there may exist some correlation between the data and assume that each data entity is independent, which is not the case majority of the time. Specifically, a temporal correlation may exist in data generated from the user’s continuous publication of data. If an adversary obtains such correlation information from other sources, then the adversary may infer users’ private data from the published data. Therefore, it is necessary to measure (or analyze) the privacy leakage of traditional differential privacy mechanisms, irrespective of whether the users’ data contains correlation over time as the data is published. And present a method under the protection of a differential privacy mechanism, which shows the maximum privacy leakage when the data involves correlation. Finally, we conduct an experiment to analyze the maximum privacy leakage, and the results show that user data’s privacy leakage can gradually increase over time as the data is published.

articleTitle: Optimal Parameter Estimation of CAPN Model for Li-ion Battery
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: Recent developments in battery technology and the reduction of battery costs have resulted in battery energy storage systems (BESS) becoming more economically viable for various power sectors and automobile applications. The degradation of BESS when used in conjunction with photovoltaics (PV) and electric vehicles (EVs) brings new challenges in both technical and economic analysis. Consequently, to ensure the reliability and safety of an energy storage system, modeling battery degradation is critical in order to maintain and replace batteries before potential issues arise. This paper presents a hybrid optimal parameter estimation technique for a combination-factor-based semi-empirical approach to evaluate the state of health (SOH) of Li-ion batteries. The parameters of the proposed model are determined using the SCA optimization algorithm, and the numerical results are confirmed by placing them side-by-side with other heuristic algorithms such as GWO, DE, HHO, and GA. The proposed model outperformed the traditional model with a SOH value of 0.9591 as compared to the previous SOH obtained 0.9467 by the traditional model.

articleTitle: Communication through Indian Sign Language: An Approach for Data Preprocessing
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: People who are specially impaired with regards to speaking and hearing find it difficult to communicate with people who are not impaired. The same is true vice-versa. For this very reason, Sign Language is necessary to be known and understood by both the parties. However, there are many people who are completely unaware of Sign Language and its importance. Hence, this project is aimed at bridging this communication gap between the two parties, and eventually, have an awareness on this importance of Sign Language. The paper presents an introductory analysis for the development of the Indian Sign Language (ISL) Recognition System. The primary focus of the paper is to discuss various steps involved in the formation, preprocessing, and augmentation of the dataset. The paper also briefly discusses the various steps performed after preprocessing to train and implement the model, with the focus on the systems based on Artificial Neural Networks.

articleTitle: ML based Prediction for Grid support in a Solar Photovoltaic Electric Vehicle Charging Station
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: In the wake of environmental protection and all other inter-continental resolutions, the transportation is slowly shifting towards less polluting alternatives. Electric vehicle (EV) transformation in the transportation sector would be a better choice to reduce huge amounts of direct greenhouse gas emissions (GHG), though there are many factors involved such as source of power used for charging, pollution due to manufacturing process and disposal of hazardous materials that adds up to polluting factors. To maximize the reduction of GHG emissions, charging of EVs with a renewable energy source and reuse of EV parts in a sustainable manner is a crucial step. Globally, the governments have started supporting Electric Vehicle transportation with many schemes to encourage public interest for buying [1]. Accommodating electricity for conveyance would soar the power requirement for charging and hence increasing the burden on the grid. Under these conditions existing grid has to be supported with renewable power sources, to reduce the stress on the grid and environmental pollution. The solar photovoltaic (PV) systems are considered to be the best suitable choice for off-grid and grid-tied EV charging stations. As the solar power is intermittent in nature, it cannot provide a stand-alone and reliable solution. But if a smart controller for predicting the optimized utilization of grid power, this solar powered EV charging station can act as a sustainable power source. The proposed work deals with grid power forecasting based on solar PV availability and EV charging demand requirement in a Solar PV based EV charging station. A machine learning oriented model with a set of algorithms applied to datasets and correlation analysis using a python program was also carried out to identify the most dependent inputs and least dependent inputs for more sophisticated analysis. A linear SVM model with least RMSE of 0.07282 is found as the best technique for this implementation.

articleTitle: A Study on the Impact of SDBRs on the Fault Ride-through Capability of DFIG based Wind Farms
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: The objective of this research is to examine the effect of different series dynamic braking resistors on the fault ride through (FRT) capability of grid-connected doubly fed induction generator (DFIG) based wind farms. It is absolutely necessary for the FRT capabilities to ensure that the system’s stability and dependability are preserved even in the event of grid outages. In order to improve a DFIG’s FRT capabilities, the study investigates the function of a Series Dynamic-Braking Resistor (SDBR) in the stator, rotor, or grid circuit. Specifically, the research evaluates the effect of three various placements of dynamic braking resistors on the fault recovery time capability of a DFIG-based wind farm. The study also compared the impact of these locations on current peak and reactive power generation from different perspectives. Simulation results show that the type and characteristics of the dynamic braking resistor are critical to the FRT performance of the system. The results of this study can help the design and operation of DFIG-based wind farms to improve fault tolerance and reliability.

articleTitle: Understanding Cloud Structures from Satellite Images using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: With the advancement of remote sensing technology, many high-resolution satellite images have been produced that can be used in a variety of disciplines, including assessing crop yields and monitoring land cover and pollution in the ocean and on land. However, the hit back to this occurs when thick clouds block the path of identification of ground level objects. Around 65% of the earth’s outer surface is covered with clouds hence this has become a major problem. To encounter this issue, we discuss some of the deep learning techniques like convolution neural networks (CNN), for the detection of cloud shapes. The semantic segmentation technique namely U-Net was chosen in this paper as the base architecture as it works well on very fewer training samples and provides a better result. Also, the computation cost is very less which is a major advantage compared to other segmentation models as the non-availability of freely available data owing to many security and investment issues. The paper introduces a new architecture for this problem statement which is an improvement to the U-Net architecture which majorly uses the concept of altering the skip connections in different to improve the way the information is passed on. The dataset used here is a derived version of NASA Worldwide view data which is widely used for cloud segmentation. The evaluation results show significant improvement in terms of accuracy.

articleTitle: An Autoencoder-based Efficient Scheme for DDoS Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: In today’s time, as businesses and organizations rely heavily on their online presence to carry out their operations and most of the operations are being managed and performed by the different stakeholders being remote, Distributed Denial of Service (DDoS) attacks have become a significant concern for the industries. Most of the existing models for detecting DDoS attacks were evaluated using only a single dataset which does not represent the entire range of possible network traffic and attack scenarios. We propose an autoencoder-based approach for DDoS detection using a Double Autoencoder model, which combines the power of unsupervised learning with supervised learning. The proposed approach is evaluated on the CICDDoS2019 and NSL-KDD datasets and is able to outperform state-of-the-art DDoS detection techniques. The model uses the reconstructed error values to distinguish between normal and DDoS traffic and is able to learn both the normal and abnormal traffic patterns. The proposed method is also able to generalize well to different datasets, demonstrating its potential for real-world applications.

articleTitle: Battery Energy Storage Sizing and Operational Strategy for Microgrid with State of Charge Scenarios
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: Microgrids (MGs) are a key component in the growing renewable energy integration with the utility grid, which is necessary to fulfil the increasing load demand. MG and its energy management systems can focus on developing optimal operation plans to maximise the use of renewable sources, including battery energy storage (BES), at the lowest cost. The BES capacity with its initial charge supports the optimal operation. The difficulties of MG economic operation are a large number of variables and constraints, such as the satisfying energy demands, the BES capacity, the operating reserve, the charge/discharge efficiency of BES, and the distributed generator capacity. Thus, this challenge is complex and needs an efficient approach to achieve MG goals with optimal BES capacity, considering zero renewable power curtailment. In this study, cost-based problem formulation has been done to determine the optimal BES size with the minimisation of operating cost by considering different scenarios under defined constraints. Here, the formulated problem is complex. It is solved using meta-heuristic algorithms such as arithmetic optimisation algorithm, grey wolf optimisation (GWO), and particle swarm optimisation to determine the BES size. Its performance comparison is also carried out. In comparison to others, the GWO provides the lowest MG operation cost with the optimal BES size. Furthermore, results show that using BES reduces MG operation costs by 64% compared to a scenario without BES.

articleTitle: Diabetic Retinopathy Detection based on LBP and Statistical Features using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Computer, Electronics & Electrical Engineering & their Applications (IC2E3)
abstract: Diabetic retinopathy (DR) is an eye disease involving retina that may develop as a complication of diabetes and can lead to significant vision impairment in its early stages and may later cause even the blindness. Diagnosis of DR is typically accomplished by analysing non-invasive fundus images. This paper introduces a new method for detecting DR, which comprises the extraction of Local binary patterns (LBP) and statistical features from the fundus images, followed by the training of Machine learning (ML) models. The performance of the introduced features for detecting the DR is evaluated on a benchmark dataset. It is found that the combination of LBP and statistical features achieves significantly encouraging detection performance on SVM, k-NN, ANN, and Logistic regression (LR) classifiers, as compared to using the features individually. Among these classifiers, the detection performance of SVM is quite encouraging than others.
